1 gseragyi pha bong]gangs ri'i las dbang la dri ba/ 11skyod sdug gi 'bod ba/ 73bsngags tshig gnon nu'i mgrin dbyangs/ 77pha yul gyi lang tshor phul ba'i skyes chung / 19lhag bsam :ltag gi gzegs ma/ 81'char snang tshig gi me tog 83skal ldan mchod ba'i me tog 85nges don srid ba'i slon me/ 91rlung khab dang drang bden gyi bar do ba/ 95thog ma'i gtam/ 97rten 'brel srid pa'i 'khor yo/ 101shes rab rgan po'i 'phel gtam gyi dris lan/ 103re bcol 105bar byang smon tshig 107par byang smon tshig 108bar byang smon tshig 109gab tshig rig pa'i rol med/ 110gab lan ni/ 111rjes dran gyi rab byed/ 113mchod ba'i sbyin phung / 113sngon byung lo tsā pa'i sku drin dran ba/ 117gangs ri'i mgon po rgyang nas dran ba'i mgur/ 119
dkar chag tsosa chen yom yom du sgul dus/ 123byin rlabs dngos grub 'gugs ba'i pho nya/ 127drang slong rgan bo'i bden gtam/ 133gser gyi pha 'ong 137'grin yig gi rab byed/ ci 141zhu 'grin dri za'i nda zang 141zhu 'dzin g.yer kha'i dril bu/ 145zhu 'dzin dge legasanta ma 'drin ba'i skya rengs/ 151zhu 'dzin g.yas 'khyil dung gi rang sgra/ 155zhu 'drin stan tshig dpyid mgo'i me rtog 159zhu 'dzin tshangs sras mgrin dbyangs/ 163thol byung gi mgur/ 167brtan gsol byis ba'i mgur dbyangs/ 111zhu 'jin gzhan gsos bu po'i mgrin glu/ 175gsol 'debs kyi rab byed/ 181'brug ba mchog sprul 7rje btsun blo zos rgya mtsho'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs phu med bdud rtsi'i bum bzangaka 181zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'chi med rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/ 183dbar skrun smon tshig 185
ched brjod dang dpar skrun gsal bshad/dge༄/ /ser byes dge bshes lha rams pa rong po blo bzang snyan grags lags kyis/bod pyi nang du grwa sa nas grwa sar 'grims nta/ mdo sngags gzhung chen dag la 'dzin grwa'i zem pa rim 'dzigs kyis yang dang bskyar du gsan bsam slob gnyer gyi zhor du/rang lo bco lnga bcu drug tsam nas rtsom yig bris pa rnams brjod don rmad du byung ba srol rgyun gyi lugs bzang po dang sbrel zhing / rjod byed kyi sdeb sbyor 'jam zhing stan la 'jebs shing go ma ba/ gna' deng gi gzhung lugs khag la ring du sbyangs shing 'dris bar byas pa'i shes rab kyi rtsal dang rnam 'gyur mngon par gsal zhing / lung dang rigs pa'i sgrub byed kyi zil dang dbal rno ba/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mkhas pa'i sngon byon dam ba dag gi rjes su rkang pa 'jog pa'i blo stobs kyi nus mthu che ba/ slog pa bo'i blo ngor 'jug ba bde zhing / yul dus kyi dgos mkho'i gnas bab dang 'tsham ba'i ljags rtsom dag kha 'jor du mi 'gro zhing / phyogs bsgrigs kyis gsung rtsom bod zeng du dbar lhan bgyis na/ blo zos kyi mig la phyogs lhung gi dri mas ma gos shing /don gnyer dang ldan la/ legs nyes rnam bar 'byed ba'i rnam daphyod can dag gis gzigs na/ skal ba bzang po dag la mgu ba skyed pa'i legs bshad kyi rin thang ha cang chen po yod pa ze tshom na dgos so/ /des na da lam bod kyi dpe mdzod khang nas skad yig deb zeng bcu gcig bar dbar spyon zhus ba lags so//zhes dge bshes lhag rdor gyis pyi lo 2 13 zla 8 tshes 6 la/
sngon gleng /༄༅rgya/ /'das zin pa'i kho bo'i rtsom rig blo sbyong gi brgyud rim la phyir dran byed skabs/bag chags shig gam yang na dga' phyogs shig gis chung dus nas rtsom yig gi skor la rang bzhin gyis dga' zhen dang blo mos yod pa dang / slob 'bring 'grim pa'i skabs su yang / bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod dang / dri med kun ldan/ mi dbang rtogs brjod sogs klog skabs snyan 'jebs ldan pa'i ming tshig dang / tshig grub kyi sdeb sbyor stan mo dag mthong skabs blor 'dzin pa dang / yang na zur 'don gyis tshigs bcad thar thor re 'bri rgyur dga' mos yod//phyi lo 1984 lor rong bo dgon chen du dgun chos dam bca' grol ba dang dus khom cung zad yod ba dang stabs bstun/ rma mgur rnam rgyal gling du smyo lags grags ba tshamadabus kyi 'bras snyangs sgo mang gi dge bshes lha rams pa yin la/ khong de dus gcan tsha sa khul du tha snyad rig gnas dang bcas pa la mkhas pa'i skad grags ha cang che zhing dgung lo 8 lhag la phebs yod/)bzhugs pa'i drung du phyin te/ khong gi mdun nas snyan ngag me long ma dang / bod mkhas pa'i snyan 'grel dang / dper brjod sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos smon 'gro lo tsā ba tshe dbang don grub kyi sras 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje'i drung nas snyan ngag gsan cing / dgung lo 31 steng brtsams pa'i snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu bcas kyi khrid rgyun zhus/ de dus khong dgung lo bsgras pas sbyan mi gsal na yang / gzhung tshig gi mgo smos pa tsam gyis zugs thog nas shar shar skyor te dper brjod mang po'i thad sor/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen mo dang bod mkhas kyi skor la sgrung mi 'dra ba re 'chad cing /le'u gsum pa'i sgra rgyan gyi skabs su/ mdzes mdzes dang / snyan snyan/ mang mang zer ba sogs legs sbyar nang bzhin bod skad la mi thon zhing / dngos gnas bshad na/ sgra
gu gseragyi bong /'dra yang go don mi 'dra ba ston nus pa dper na/ rje rin po ches mdzad ba'i bstod sprin rgya mtsho dang / gsung thor bu'i nang bzhugs pa'i sgra rgyan gyis spras pa'i bka' rtsom de 'dra dgos nges kyang / de 'dra ha cang mthong dkon zhing / zhang zhung ba'i rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod du bris pa'i sgra rgyan lta bu de tsho la dpe bltas nas 'bri thub na legs/ de min lad zlos lta bus gang yang mi yong / tshogs dbus su grwa mang gis 'don cha mnyam du 'don skabs/ gsung byin rlabs can de tsho'i tshig spyor la do snang gyis dang / stan cha dang bajid bag mi 'dra bas stan ngag shes mkhan zhig dang / mi shes mkhan zhig gis 'don ba bton pa gnyis la khyad par gnam sa lta bu yod ces gsungs bas/ gyis tshogs su 'don pa 'don pa'i skabs su lha dang bla ma/ chos srung dag gi bstod ba dang 'grin bcol de tsho 'don skabs don dag go min la ma bstos par tshig spyor sems la zug ste mig nang du mchi ma sargar ba yang lan mang byung / brgyad cu'i gya grangs nang dgon pa'i nang tha snyad rig gnas skor la sbyang ba bya rgyur bkag sdom che bar ma zad/ go grangs nang la yang dge skul tshos dus deb khag la blta mi chog ba'i tshogs gtam yang yang gtong bzhin yod//bar skabs shig sgeg steng yongs 'dzin rin po che 7rje blo bzang dpal ldan mi pham mtsho byung bzhad pa'i lang tshos sku tshe gang la snga pyir brtsams pa'i chab lhagag phyogs bsgrigs kyi dpe deb cig mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe snyan khang gis dpar 'grems byas byung bar/ des bod khul gyi slob grwa khag dang / dgon lde khag gi nang tshigs bcad rtsom yig 'bri rgyur sgul shugs kyi nus ba chen bo ron yod/ dper na/ sbrang char sogs dus deb khag gi nang du yang gzhung 'di'i tshig 'gros mngon bar gsal ba'i rtsom yig 'phro rim 'phror mjal rgyu yod/ kha dbugs kyi rgyu phyogs de'i dbang gis kho bos kyang gzhung de'i tshig ris mang bo blor 'dzin byas par ma zad/ gyi lo 1997 lor bka' drin zla
rdzon theng] rngo med 7rje shar gtong rin bo che'i zhabs zhur pe cin du bcar skabs chab shog nang gi khrid rgyun gang yod don gnyer chen pos zhus shing / da lta'i bar gzhan la yang tshar 2lhag khrid khul byas phyong / da cha kho bo'i bris rtsom 'jur ba mang dag cig phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas blta skabs/ rtogs brjod dang zhu 'phrin khag gis gtsos ba'i tshigs bcad dag la yang yongs 'dzin rin bo che'i chab phyosnag gi tshig 'gros kyi zhag ji zhig rang bzhin gyis 'gos 'dug pa'i tshor snang ster zhing / lhag par du bod du sdod skabs bris pa rnams la tshig rgyan gyi ldeb spyor de ga rang du 'dug /deng sang bod mi nang gang du yang go sla ba kha skad lta bu'i tshigs bcad ma bris na klog mkhan dkon zhing / tshig rgyan shas che ba'i rtsom 'bri mkhan je nyung nas je nyung du 'gro bzhin mchis/ gnas bab de yin nam gang ltar yang nye lam nas nged kyi bris rtsom rnams la yang mngon gsal dod pos 'gyur ba 'gro bzhin pa kho bos kyang tshor gyi yod kyang bzang rtags shig yin min bshad dka'/ gang ltar rje sa paṇa gyis/ yi ge 'dus ba'i bdag nyid can/ /don gyi ngo bo brda sprod pa/ /de dang de yi khyad par dag /ston bas tshig ces rab tu bshad/ /de dag phan tshun sbyar ba las/ /brjod ba gsal bar ston te ngag /de bsags pa las rab byed sogs/ /chos kyi phung po'i bar du grub/ /ces ming dang tshig phan tshun sbyar ba'i brjod ba bsags ba las rab byed grub bar gsungs ba ltar/ tshig rgyan gtso bor byed ba dang / tshor 'du lhang nger 'jo ba gang yin na'ang don bzang ba dang tshig 'bru bzang ba yin na ma sa bar 'gyur ba ni/ rje tsong kha bas/ rin 4 che gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba las/ de ltar don gyi gnad rnams ma 'argyugs na//tshig sbyor dman na nyes pa chung mod kyang / /rgyal ba nyid kyis gsung rab bsngags ba na//don bzang ba dang tshig 'bru bzang po zhes/ /gsungs shing shin tu dkar ba'i khang bzang la'ang / /bsil zer byed pa'i 'od skyas rgyug pa bzhin/ /don bzang ba la yid 'phrog
rngo gser gyi pha 'ongadtshig sbyor gyis/ /spras par gyur na ches cher mtshes bar 'gyur/ /zhes spyir btang don gyi gnad ma 'argyugs na/ tshig spyor dman na'ang nyes skyon chung yang / tshig don gnyis ka bzang na ches cher ma sa bar 'gyur ba dper na/ shin tu dkar ba'i khang bzang la zla 'od kyis byug pa bzhin du phun sum tshogs bar 'gyur bar gdams ba ltar dgos nges kyang / 'dir lag tu son rigs rnams ni/ gzhung chen khag la slob gnyer gyi zhar dang nor la 'phral 'bral du bris pa'i rtsom yin pas bzang zhan ci rigs yod ba'ang smos ma dgos shing / bod kyi sbrang char dang mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal/ bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal sogs dus deb dang rtsom sgrig ba dag gis kho bo'i rtsom yig dag la mthong chen gyi rgyab skyor dang skyed sring gi byams skyong gnang med na/ nga'i lo na gzhon dus kyi rtsom yig 'di tshor gson shugs rgyas ga la srid//kho bos rtsom yig gi las ka phal mo che ni/ rang la chos dang rig gzhung gi lam ston gnang mkhan bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag gi rnam pa ra thar pa dang / bshad khrid khag yi ger bkod de skal mnyam rigs mthun rnams la phan zogs shig byung na/ de ni bsod nams gsog ba'i go skabs shig red bsams nas mas 'brel dngos zob kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams rmya bka' khrid dang rnam thar dag yi ger 'phebs pa'i don du dka' las mang po zhig brgyab pa yin/ dper na/ bod nang du bdag gi bka' drin zla med 'jam dbyangs bla ma grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho sku zeng brgyad ba'i yongs ladzon7rje dge 'dun bstan 'dzin gyi rnam thar dang / 7rje shar gdong blo bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dang / khong gi lam rim chen mo'i bshad khrid kyis gtsos ba'i gsung bshad khag sgra thag gzhir bzung zin bris su bkod cing / rgya gar du zabs rjes su yang / sgyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal mchog sku zeng bcu bzhi ba chen po'i mdzad rnam byams brtse dang drang bden gyi bla srog dang / khong gi gzhung chen khag
sngon gleng1 5 khrid gnang ba bka' 'bum bod ka ba nas cha ba bar yig 'phebs zhu dag dang / rtsom sgrig zhus bar ma zad/ da dung mu mthud byed bzhin yod ba dang / se rar gtsang ba mkhan zur rin bo che'i mdzad rnam dang / drang nges bshad khrid zin bris su bkod de dpar lhan byas pa sogs zhing mchog dam ba dag la brten pa'i bzugad nams bsags ci thub byas kyang / gzhung chen slob gnyer gyi gnon shugs kyis dbang gis dus tshod ma 'dang ba'i brel zing che ltabs/ bris rtsom khag la da lta zhib lta byed skabs 'dod blo yongs su tshims ba'i snang ba zhig shar zub kyi mi 'dug la/ deng sang dra lam myul nas rtsom yig lta klog byed rgyu las/ deb lag tu bzung nas zhib tshags lta mkhan lo re nas zla re bzhin je nyung du 'gro bzhin yod pas/ dpe cha dpar skrun bya rgyu'i dgos dmigs kyang 'grub re dka' bas sgyid lug ste/ rtsom yig 'bri klog la sngon chad nang bzhin dang ga yang ha cang chung //snga lo lha sa 'od kyi dpe mdzod khang gi 'gan 'dzin dge bshes lhag rdor mchog la kho bo'i bris rtsom 'jor ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs na dbar smyun byed thub min bka' 'dri zhus lan so gang zub byed nges kyi zhal bzhes gnang don bzhin/ cha tshang lag son ma byung yang bod nang gi dus deb khag tu bkod pa'i tshigs bcad rtsom yig rnams phal mo che phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nta/ bod ka pa dang / btsan rgyal mtho slob kha shas nang slob khrid ched gra sgrig ma zin du bkod ba rnams kyang nye bar bsags te/ pod kha ba/ gzhan rnam thar mi 'dra ba rnams pod ga pa dang / nga pa/ lo rgyus khag pod ca pa/dogs dargyad dang zin bris khag kyang rim bar pod gzhan du bzhag ste/ don gnyer can tshor spyan bstar zhu 'char lags/ rtsom yig rnams phyogs sgrig skabs 'tshol zhib dang /dpar rtsar 'jug ba/ zhu dag sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad shes rig las byed dge 'dun don yod lags dang / pod dang po'i tshigs bcad rnams bya blo bzang mee ring lags
gu tsogaser gyi pha 'ong /dang / byams brtsedang drang bden gyi bla srog rta bo phun tshogs rdo rje lags kyis bskyar du bar rtsar bcug pa dang / bkur 'os zogs po dge bshes lhag rdor lags kyis deb 'di dag bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gis dpar skrun gnang rgyur zhal bzhes mthun 'gyur gnang ba ma zad ched brjod gnang ba dang / a rir gnas bzhugs grogs po dge 'dun rab gsal lags dang / zhinyi byes ba grwa tshang gi grogs po sku zhabs 'bring ba 'jigs med lags gnyis nas rtsache'i dus tshod btang ste/ bklags tho ljags bris gnang ba sogs sku ngal bskyon gnang mkhan rnams dang / lhag bar du ha sa bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi mthun 'gyur 'og dbar 'grems gnang ba la snying thag pa nas bka' drin dang zugs rje bla med du che zhes zhu rgyu yin/ zhes bod rgyal lo 2139 ) lo 2 12 zla 7 tshes 6 nyin rtsom pa po rong bo rgyal ba'i myu gur 'bod pas bris pa 'dis kyang bod kyi rig gzhung 'di nyid mi nyams gong du 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig //
mdzub mo ri ston/dge༄/ /ser byes dge bshes lha rams ba rong bo blo bzang snyan grags mchog gi snyan rtsom bklags ba//lo 'di'i dbyar khar phran rgya gar du gung gseng la pyin/ skabs der rong bo blo bzang snyan grags lags dang bka' mol lhug por zhu rgyu'i gau skabs byung / bka' mol de ni kha bar thog zhus shing / ngas nyan bzhin nyan bzhin rong bo blo bzang snyan grags lags kyis mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i dka' gnad rnams shar se 'chad kyin pa tshor byung / nga tsho'i kha par thog gi skad cha rnams grub mtshams slar yang bsam blo zhig btang //mi lo 25 tsam gyi sngon la/ phran dang blo bzang stan grags lags gnyis 'i chos grogs yin/ nga tsho ni bla ma gcig gi slob ma dang dkyil 'khor gcig gi lha tshogs yin/ blo bzang snyan grags lags ni/ rig pa no ba dang blo bzang snyan grags lags ni 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mkhas ba'i snyan pa ni dus de tsam zhig nas rgyas pa red/ de nas bzung / zan btsan byol ba'i mi tshe ring mo 'dir zhugs shing / khong ni gzhis su bzhugs te mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas ba la mkhyen pa rgyas pa red/ rim gyis khong yang btsan byol du phebs shing / skabs der khong ni chos shes pa'i dge bshes tsam zhig ma yin par chos nyams su len pa'i dge bshes rnal 'byor pa zhig tu'ang gyur zin 'dug /btsan byol du phebs nas ring po ma thogs par khong ni 7rgyal ba'i bka' 'grum zhu sgrig 'gan 'dzin du gyur cing / bod mi mang thad bskos sbyi 'thus dang da cha dge lugs sgyi 'thus gnang bzhin pa red/ da dung gdan sa chen po zhig nas dge bshes lha rams ba'i mtshan gnas bzhes mkhan gyi dge ba'i bshes shig tu'ang gyur pa red//
5tsho gser gyi pha bong /sngon gyi bstan bcos rnams su 5mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas ba la bslab ba mthar son ba zhes ngom srol yod pa red/ ngom srol de ni dge bshes blo bzang snyan grags lags la mtshon na ngom ba zhig ma red/ de ni dngos yod cig red/ khong dang lhan du chos dang rig gnas kyi skor la bzo gleng zhig zhus tshe/ dka' ba'i gnad rnams la lung dang rigs ba'i rgyab rten dang / mkhas ba dang mkhas pa'i gsung 'bum bsdur nas rnam par 'byed ba/ mdo dang bstan bcos bsdur nas legs par 'grel ba sogs legs bshad kyi bdud mi'agyed la/ des rgyu byas te/ ngas khong la/ che khyed ni 7rgyal ba sku zeng bcu bzhi ba'i zhabs la gtugs pa'i co rje bla ma rin po che red/gces yang yang zhus myong //de ltar/ lo ngo bcu phrag gsum gyi ring thos bsam dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la brel ba'i dge bshes lags kyis rang gi gsung rtsom phyogs sgrig cig 'don 'char yod ba de la bklags ca'am bskyar zhib cig 'bri rogs zhes bka' phebs ba'i skabs su/ ring nas 'dris pa'i mched grogs shig gi grogs nas dang / chos kyi spun grogs su gyur pa'i dam tshig la rgyar brten nas ngas de ltar mi lcogs zhes zhu dka' bar gyur/dge bshes lags kyi gsung rtsom skor ma zhus pa'i gong la/ 'brel ba yod pa zhig ni/ da lta'i bod kyi rtsom rig skor yin/ de yang 'das pa'i mi lo 5 tsam gyi ring la/ bod kyi rig gnas ni srol rgyun gyi rig gnas bcu'i khyab khongs las brgal (rig gnas bcu'i 'grel bshad dang de dag gis rig gnas yod tshad bsdu ba de 'di'i skabs don min/)te/ deng rabs kyi rig gnas sam bslab bya 'dra min gyi rjes 'ded mkhan zhig tu gyur cing / skabs de dag tu yi ge shes pa'i grangs 'bor yang 'phar te/bstan bcos rtsom pa ni ha cang dar srol che bar gyur/ dar srol che ba de'i khrod dus deb dang dpe deb sogs ni grangs 'bor che ba zhig thon par gyur/ nga tshos da lta'i bod kyi

rtogs ba brjod ba'i rab byed/ 13de slad rje bzhugs se ra rtse'i/ /gzim khang byin 'bar 'og min zhing / /gsol 'debs bsags sbyang dbyad pa'i sgom/ /sum bsgril gnas kyi mchog tu bsngags/ /'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun brgyud sogs/ /mkhas grub gser ri'i lhun po yi/ /gral dpung bsgrigs ba'i yi khri'i mtsho/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal dge ldan zhing / /gnas der mkhan chen shrī bzang /lhas/ ༵/ ༷༷ ༈ pa( /shā ṭā 〉〉〉 la/dhī/la/ pa/dri ༷ lha pa/ rnyi/ /nga 'ab/ sna /spya rta// mgrin la sogs ba'i/ /rjes su gnang ba legs gsan te/ /legs bshad nor bu'i mdzod dbang bsgyur/ /nyer bdun lo mjug gnas rnying bas/ /bka' lung rdo rjes zhus pa bzhin/ /lo gsum chos 'khor rgya chen pos/ /se ra grwa tshang chos kyis bskyangs/ /dngos dang mnal ltas ngo mtshar bas/ /bsus bzhin byams chen bde ba can/ /skyong bar phebs mee me rtog char/ /'ja' tshon lha yi rol mor sbrags//de'i tshe grags stan zhags pa yis/ /mkhas kun yid kyi gyang bo che/ /dbang med bzung bas phyogs kun gyi/ /'khor slob rgya mtsho'i sprin du dkrigs/ /bkras lhun skal bzang khyams yangs su/ /po ti bcu lhag dka' ba'i gnas/ /'bru snon brgal lan ngo mtshar bas/ /lhar bcas mkhas rgus bstod bsngags 'jur/ /ba zug byams chen rgyal byed tshal/ /rim par po 3 lnga drug gi/ /'chad nyarna lha ja'i sgra chen gyis/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan dgung du btegs/ /lha ri grub dbang rgya mtsho'i gtso/ /mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho'i drung / /ḍā khri'i sgyu ma'i mnal 'phrul gyis/ /mtshams sbyar bla slob lhan cig 'dzoms/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med rgyud/ /rtsa'grel man ngag zhal shes bcas/ /'phags bod rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gzhung / /dngos grub nor bu'i gter du bzhes/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhis rgyas btab ba'i/ /rgyud lde rgya mtsho'i gsang ba'i gnad/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs bcas/ /rogs ldan chos kyi mdzod du brtsegs//rgyud dang grub chen sbya ba'i gzhung / /snyan brgyud man ngag za mo rer/ /gegs sel bogs 'don myong grub bcas/ /rim gnyis zab lam yud kyis gshegs/ /bde stong seṅge'i lder
14gser gyi pha bong /non gyis/ /tha mal snang zhen glang bo'i gtsug /dum bur gsil ba'i grags stan rnga/ /gnas gsum ḍā khris phyogs su brdungs/ /rin spungs sde ba'i bzhugs gral pu /sa skya'i chen por rlom pa mang / /dri med lung rigs gnam lcags kyis/ /lhun po thal bar brlags bzhin pham/ /se rar mkhas stan grwa tshang gi /'chad nyan rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i rjer/ /chos rje don yod dbal ldan bas/ /su 'os brtags pas dgongs bzhed 'khrungs/ /'od gsal mnal lam sgrol ma dang / /dam can chos rmya rgyal po yis/ /rje 'dir tshad mas lung bstan gyis/ /'grin las sgo brgya yangs bor phyes/ /brag dog bdud kyi btsan dug gis/ /chags snang sbyor ba rtsom ba dag /tshar bcad pham pa'i cho nge'i sgra/ /snying rje'i yul las gzhan du ci//snar thang paṇa chen ye rtse'i drung / /'dod chos dgyes dgur stsal ba las/ /dpal ldan dus kyi dngor lo sogs/ /dngos zhal gzigs mjal lung yang bstan/ /dbus phebs chibs bar snye thang pu /landam ba'i rdo rje tsong kha ba/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs rgyas drung / /dung dkar 'dud ba'i rmi ltas byung / /de dus dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi/ /dka' bcu rab 'byams dge ba'i bshes/ /blo gsal brgya zag gsum bzhi tsam/ /rgyun du zhabs bsten chos kyis bskyangs//mkhas grub don yod dbal ldan pa/ /zhi bar gzhol bas gdan sa bar/ /kun mkhyen dge 'dun rgya mtsho mchog /spyan 'dren khur bzhes zab chos zhus//mgon 'di'i gzhan dbang zugs rje'i mthus/ /gzhan don rgya chen de tsam zhig /'di snang sred pas 'ching ba rnams/ /rang don sgrub la rings pa min/ /dpal ldan 'bras dkar sangs ba'i lder/ /rje btsun thams cad mkhyen ba'i drung / /gzhung lugs rab 'byams mkhas mang pas/ /dka' gnad dri ba rgya cher zhus/ /blo bzang rgyal ba sras bcas skya/ /legs bshad zab rgyas dgongs pa'i mthil/ / ji bzhin gzigs ba'i bka' lan dbyangs/ /mkhas rnams mtshod pa'i sgrin du spros/ /deng dus po ti gnyis gsum re/ /'chad la mkhas pa'i ming 'dogs na/ /gang la'ang thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ /'di ci zhes te kun ngo mtshar/ /sna tshogs 'od 'khro'i gzhal yas su/ /pha gcig blo bzang chub ba'i zhal/ /dngos gzigs dbus su
rtogs pa brjod ba'i rab byed/ 15'chad nyan la/ /gtsor gyis srung mas grogs mdzad gsungs/ /ring nas sras bcas rgyal ba dang / /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyis/ /rjes bzung thabs shes cher brtan pas/ /bden tshig ji bzhin grub rtags byung / /grags che'i grub rigs dregs ldan gyis/ /ma zul gdon bgegs bye ba'i snying / /bka' bsgo tsam gyis rtswartse'i zil/ /nyi mas zhu bzhin lhag med bgyis//'gro ba'i srog dang 'gyor ba la/ /gnod ba gtsang dbus sde gzar dmag /zlog la bye ri stag gi rtser/ /sgrub pa'i cho ga chos bzhin bsgrubs/ /dmigs gtad grub ba phra mo res/ /dam can mgon po rnam sras sogs/ /'phrul snang sgyu ma'i rngams zil gyis/ /'thab dang 'khrug ba'i g.yul ngo zhi/ /dam can chos kyi rgyal po yis/ /'jigs rngams gar sgya stangs stabs bcas//bstan bcos dbu ma'i sbyi don la/ /kho bos bdag gir byed ces gsungs/ /se rar mnal lam ra mo che'i/ /jo bo'i zugs da'i 'ja' 'od sne/ /rje 'dir zug las 'od dbag med//spros ba smon lam 'dzugs pa'i rtags//rgyal ba tsong kha'i bka' brgyud bar/ /yi dam gtso bor gzhin rje gshed/ /mdzad bas chos kyi bar chad bgegs/ /nyer zhi shes rab khyad bar 'khrangs/ /'jam dbal zugs rje nor bu'i mdzod/ /khros pa'i gar mdzad dus dgra'i dbang / /rta mgrin yang gsang la sogs pas/ /rjes bzung 'phrin las mkha' ltar khyab/ /dgung grangs bdun cu sa pho khyir/ /gangs can mgon po'i rgyal tshab tu/ /se rar mi 'jigs seṅge'i khrir// zhabs mthil rdo rje'i ri mo bkod/ /zugs rje'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las/ /mdo sngags legs bshad nor bu'i char//mtha' yas gdul bya'i zhing khams su/ /byang chen myu gu'i gsos su phab/ /khyud bar che ba bzhis 'phags ba'i/ /pha gcig blo bzang rgyal ba'i bka'/ /byang chub lam gyi rim ba yi//zab khrid sbyi chos 'dod dgur sgyin/ /chos dang srid kyis dregs ldan pa'i/ /phyogs rmya che ba ma lus kun/ /mkhas btsun bzang bo'i grags snyan gyis/ /bkugs pas gus bkur blor mi shong / /dgung grangs don gsum lcags glang lor/ /bde chen gsang ba sngags mkhar pu/rtsa'ajug phar tshad byams chos sogs/ /dka' gnad mdud pa'i gsang rgya krol/ /se rar
16gser gyi pha 'ong /skal ldan bgrang yas par/ /gzhung chen so so'i ṭīkka dang / /dka' gnad mtha' daphyod spyi don sogs/ /legs bshad gser gyi thang mar brdal/ /nub cig byis ba shos dkar can/ /byung nas slob ma 'di dag las/ /'ga' rer blo skyed yong ba las/ /phal cher sems chos rgyab tu bsnol/ /sbyi gtsug thog gis btab gyur kyang / /theg chen blo sbyong mi gtong zhing / /bdag 'dzin nyakhri ba chod ba zhig /byung na blo skyed 'ongs pa yin//de slad skal ba ldan rnams la/ /lam rim blo sbyong gtsor gyis zhes/ /gsungs pas rgya 'od slo spyong gzhung / /lo rer 'chad 'doms rgya cher bgyis/ /darnga mi bskyod rdo rje zhes//grags des rje 'di'i sku yon la/ /yid ches rang gi phar phyin gyi/ /ṭīkka'i legs bshad skyes su btegs/ /gzhung 'dir 'phrin las 'phel thabs su/ /dgag sgrub lung rigs nor bu'i char/ /thabs shes rdo rje'i mkha'ad〉ngas las/ /rdzobs zhes gsol 'debs yang yang zhus//kun mkhyen dge 'dun rgya mtshos kyang / /dar lan cis kyang mdzad dgos zhes/ /zhib rgyas gtan tshigs 'beel ba bcas/ /bka' lung rdo rje'i lcid du phab/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / /dam can chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /gzigs snang mdzad bzhin klu sgrub kyi/ /dgongs rgyan bstan ba'i dpyid du brtsams/ /rmad byung legs bar bshad pa'i mthus/ /rkarma dge ldan lta ba la/ /zugs dad bdag nyid chen po 'dir/ /skyes bcas bsngags pa 'i me tog 'thor//'phags bod gzhung brgya'i dka' ba'i gnas/ /mkha' mthar mnyam ba nyid gyur pa/ /rgya chen 'jaspru dpal dgongs pa'i mtha'/ /gzhal ba'i legs bshad phyogs las rgyal/ /de dus ri bo 〉lnga'i gzhir/ /harma ha tu'i sprul ba yis/ /garmar klu sgrub dgongs pa'i mthil/ /'dir bas khyod nyid tshim gyis gsungs/ /blo bzang tshad ma'i ston ba yi/ /bra zhib gsung gi gsang ba kun/ /'phrog byed glal ba'i gad rgyangs su/ /slog pa'i rnam thar bsam mi khyab/ /de dus go shāka rnam gnyis kyis/ /blo bzang legs bshad dgag pa'i lan/ /mdzad bzhed rkarma mi bskyod bar/ /dbang bor bzhugs rgyu'i bka' shog phul/ /ji ltar glang bos 'dam bu'i tshal//bcom bzhin log rtog bdud kyi lte/ /gcod byed lung rigs dgra sta'i mtshon/ /kun mkhyen
rtogasababarjod ba'i rab byed/ 17ye shes 'phrul du bskor/ /shāka lan rogs par brtsams grub kyang / /go lan rtsom ba'i 'phro mdzad de/ /dga' ldan yid dga'i pho brang du/ /gshegs pa gdul bya'i skal bas nongs//mkhyen rtsom cha shas re rer yang / /'jam dpal rdo rje'i rtsal rdzogs te/ /pha gcig blo bzang rgyal ba'i bka'/ /'chad pa bsngags 'os kun gyi phul/ /phar tshad dbu ma mdzod 'dul gyi//gsung rtsom spyi mtha'i legs bshad skyes/ /dngos dang zin bris glang bo'i khal/ /brtsegs ba bstan ba'i rgyan du bsgrigs/ /zhi kho yi dam du ma yi/ /bstod tshogs sgrub thabs byin rlabs kyi/ /phung bor dkrigs pa gsang ba'i mdzod/ /lam bzang sgrub pa'i dbal du byin/ /khyad par 'jam pa'i rdo rje yi/ /rtag chad mtha' bral lta ba'i lam/ /rab gsal rgyal ba dgyes pa'i gzhung / /spru ba zla med phyogs las rgyal/ /mdo rgyud 'chad rtsod rtsom pa dang / /lung rtogs bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi/ /bslab gsum 'phrin las rgyal rnga'i dbyangs/ /bstan srung rgya mtshos phyogs bcur slogs/ /bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten pa nas/ /zung 'jug grub pa chen po'i bar/ /bzod pas gsung las skyes pa'i sras/ /mkha' khyab nyi zla'i dpal du 'gran//bka'adang dgongs 'grel lde snod kyis/ /mgrin mdzes rab 'byams dge ba'i bshes/ /rdul snyed rgyas pa 'di 'dra na/ /shugs 'byung 'phrin las ji ltar 'gag /de slad deng yang mdo dbus kyis/ /mtshon pa'i rgya bod kun tu yang / /rje btsun yig ga'i 'phrin las gdugs//kun gyi gtsug na lhang jir rgyal//don drug shing pho 'brug gi lor/ /snga phyir zugs sras che rnams la/ /rgyal bstan nyer gtad dga' ldan du/ /phebs rgyu'i gsung tshig rim par gnang // dgu nyar lubor slob nyung shas bcas/ /jo bor pyi phyag smon lam gyi/ /rgyas btab gser chab 'bul 'degs kyis//zugs slon rgya che'i dmid du dkrigs/ /drung 'khod pa dag mya ngarna gyi// gdung bas smyu rim ci bzhes su/ /gsol ba btab kyang bstan ba'i mdzod/ /tshul khrims gces par srungs shig gsungs/ /rgyal bas thog mthar mi rtag gtam/ /gsungs ba gdul bya'i nyams len du//'khyer mdzod dbeen pa'i gnas sten la/ /bstan la gang phan mdzod ces gdams/ /'chi ba
18gser gyi ba bong /'od gsal chos kyi skur/ /bsres pa'i gdams pas mtshams sbyar te/ /mi pham rgyal ba'i mdun sa ru/ /'jam dpal snying po'i sras su gshegs/ /skyil krung mnyam gzhag mdzad pa'i zhal/ /bde stong ting 'dzin bden ba'i mthus/ / mdangs mdzes gzhon lus lha yi sku/ /mthong grol mig gi bdud rtsir bzhengs/ /mkha' la 'ja' sprin me tog dang / /mkha' 'gros mchod ba'i rol mo yis/ /gdung khang se ra'i gling khrod kun/ /ngo mtshar snang bas khyab par dkrigs//rmad byung bkod pa 'byams klas pa'i/ /'phrul snang rgyal ba'i gzigs mo yis/ /ma gus skye bo skal dman rnams/ /'gyod dang dad pa 'gran bzhin 'phel/ /g.yas 'khyil dung dang thod dbyug gi /ring bsrel kha dog sna tshogs can/ /'jigs byed ya ma rā dza sogs/ /rab gsal mchod ba'i rten du babs/ /rdo rje bstan skyong rgyal mo yi/ /sku rgyan g.yu byur mu tig gi/'phra tshom spungs ba'i gser gdung che/ /legs byas sdud ba'i zhing du balhan/ /snying gi mun sel 'od stong can/ /thub bstan dag gtsang padma'i gnyen/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu bkod kyis/ /dag zhing phebs pa yid re skyo/ /'on nta thugs brtse klong rum las/ /sku dang sngags zeng phyag mtshan gyi/ /ri mo bkra ba'i byin rten dngos/ /phebs pa'i gdul bya'i dbugs rab dbyung / /mdo sngags zung 'jug nor bu'i gdugs/ /bshad sgrub zung 'jug gis bltags pa'i/ /thabs shes zung 'jug dba' bo'i gtam/ /dad gus zung 'jug klong nas 'phyur//spyon pa'i lab brdol lta bu yi/ /smyo bshad chad ma mthud kyi rtsom/ /snyan pa'i ngag tu sgro btags pa'i/ /gsar ba'i gtam dang 'di mi 'dra/ /'dir 'bad dge tshogs ma dros klung //byang chen rgya mtsho'i gsos gyur te/ /'gro kun rje 'di'i rnam thar la/ /'god pa'i dpa' bo nyid gyur cig /skye ba 'dis mtshon tshe rabs kun/ /mgon 'di'i legs bshad rgya che'i gting //bshad dang sgrub bas 'dzin ba la/ /rje 'di'i go 'phang 'grub gyur cig 'dzam gling mtha' dbus kun tu yang / /rgyal bstan snying po'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /nyer gang mgon 'di'i bzhed ba'i mthil/ /rang dbang bde bas 'tsho bar shog /
rtogs pa brjod ba'i rab byed/ 19ces rang re'i yig cha'i bdag po 'jam dbal mi yi rlos gar/ lung dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug 7rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i rtogs ba brjod pa bdun rkang slob dpon dpa' bo'i rang sgra zhes pa 'di ni/ pyi lo 1998 zla 10 tshes 25 la rong bo tos bsam rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi btsun gzugs blo bzang snyan grags sam rgyal ba'i myu gur 'bod bas dge legs su spel ba'o/ /pyi lo 1998 lo'i〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉deb gsum par bkod//
rtogs ba brjod ba'i rab byed/ 21gangs lha/ ḍi kṣiṃ tram̐ ste ༷ ñtsā ༷ ༷kṣiṃ tram̐ snañdzashāshā mgon rkya ji/yos༄4rgya/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i rnam 'phrul 'od lnga'i rdul/ /snying sdug lhar shar rgyud mangs rol ldan ma/ /spru byed ro 'dzin gos dmar gzhon nu'i grogs/ /kun dga'i ngag gi me rtog char du snyil/ /gang zhig mi yi lus sten lha yi skur/ /rang krol rmad byung zub pa chen za'i srol/ /dus kyi mthar yang skye rgu'i gdung sel pu /srel ba'i byed por 'gying rnams gleng bar spro/ /'di skad thos so grub pa'i gnas brgyad sogs/ /ya mtshan gnas kyi bkod ba 'byams klas ba'i/ /gser ldan chu bo'i lho rgyud gru 'dzin zhing / /mtha' dag re slong rig pa 'byung ba'i gnas/ /zag spang nags skya sa 'dzin 'phang mtho zhing / /rong 'grog zas bcud g.yang du 'khyil ba'i gzhi/ /zho 'ong la khar 'bod ba gnyan rgya'i sder/ /sprul ba'i khye'u 'khungs pa'i gtam de ring / /bkra shis brtsegs pa'i 'phrin las skyed pa'i yum/ /lnga rig spru ba'i sngags 'chang 'gro ba'i mgon/ /yab gcig rdo rje rnam par rgyal ba'i lde/ /lhan cig chadags bskyangs pa rigs kyi sras/ /ji ltar dpyid na'i drod kyis rgyun bsrings pa'i/ /sna tshogs myu gu ldem ba'i skyed tshal du/ /bsung zhim dri ldan pad mo'i lang tsho ltar/ /'dzum ba'i bkra shis lcags glang bgrang bya'i rgyan/ /ngag dbang bkra shis zhes pa'i sprul ba zhig /yul 'dir 'khrangs zhes dkar phyogs dga' ba'i lhas/ /'o yag snye mas mchod pa'i sgrin dkrigs te//kun kyang dga' gus btsas ston gtam gyis 'das/ /e ma mun pa'i dus su yang / /snang srid 'ja' 'od rig le'i skur/ /gzigs pa'i byis pa 'di mtshar zhes/ /spru brjod lha yi rol mor mched/ /yul gyi sngags 'chang 'dus ba'i grwar/ /cho ga klog pa'i gdangs dag bas//rgan por gyur ba rnams skya lces/ /bstod pa'i mgo lcog 'di la yo/ /bcu gcig nas bzung
22gser gyi pha bong /bco brgyad bgrang bya'i bar/ /rje btsun chu dmar mo rgyan 'phrin las dang / /grub dbang 'jam dpal rdo rje'i zhabs rmya rdul/ /bsam sbyor gtsug skyes nor bu'i tog tu bkur/ /gsar rnying kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho sogs/ /bsten las dbang khrid chos bka' gdams par shar/ /lha bris bzo bslabs yig rtsal byang chub pas/ /nyin rer chos dpe lha ga ldebs brgya phrag bzhengs// rdo sbis yul du a rig dge ba'i bshes/ /byams pa dge legs rgyal mtshan dam pa'i drung // rab byung dge tshul bsnyen rogs sdom pa'i snying / /byams pa'i dam chos dar ba'i dpal du bzhes/ /pha yul ma sring gnyen krogs blos btang nas/ /sog yul chos rgyal ngag gi dbang bo'i drung / /mdo sngags gdams pa klong chen mdzod bdun sogs/ /gsan bsam chos zab rtogs pa klong du gyur/ /rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang nod dus/ /me tog byang du babs pa tshogs drug gi /zhen 'dzin rang sar grol ba'i brdar 'phrod pas/ /bla ma'i lung bstan sras kyi zu bor bsngags/ /rtse gzhung dbeen ba'i dga' tshal sgom khung pu /sgo gsum tha mal dra bar ma zugar bar/ /gter bsrung 'khor ba'i rtags mtshan sna tshogs bcas//snang zhen kun dag gang snang lha skur shar/ /gzig rlung gsum sbyangs pa cher goms pas//ras rkyang rub pa'i gtum mo'i bde drod dang / /rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pa'i rtsamadud rgya//krol ba'i bde stong nyams snang rgyun ma chad/ /khregs chod gnas lugs lta ba rtogs pa'i gdengs/ /rnyed de lhun grub thol rgal gdams pa'i gnyer/ /dka' thub nyams bzhes 'phrul gyi lde mig gis/ /sgo dbyes snang bzhi'i ye shes phyag rtser smin/ /stag mo rgod po snang dang ge tho'i gnas//gtsang dang rwa rgya dgon du gnas 'brel gyis/ /nyams rtogs mgur du bzhes bzhin lha 'dre'i gdon/ /btul ba'i ting 'dzin dmigs gtad bsam mi khyab/ /la kha sprul ba'i sku dang rgyal mkhan chen/ /lhan cig chos rgyal ngag gi dbang po'i drung / /snyo brag bka' 'bum gter gsar phur ba'i skor/ /chos bka' rgya cher bzhes bzhin snga 'gyur lugs/ /spel ba'i zugs dam rdo rje'i mdud par sgron/ /me stag zla ba dang po'i tshes gsum du/ /gnam sngon zhu ba khri
rtogs ba brjod ba'i rab byed/ 23shor rgyal mo'i dbus/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lhas/ /byin rlabs mtsho snying ma hā de wa'i yul/ /zhabs stegs 'khor lo'i ri mo legs bkod de/ /sprul sgyur ting 'dzin rol ba 'byams klas mur/ /blo sbyong nyams bzhes zab mos lus rid de/ /rje btsun mi la'i dka' spyad rgyan du bzhes/ /dar dkar lha lam brgyud tshe zhabs lham gyis/ /bshus bar rlung gis ram btegs ras skya nas/ /mtsho sman lha yis gnang bar kun mtshar nas//chos zhus bsnyen bkur mgur gyis kun yid 'azog /rma chen gnas bstod mgur ma'i glu dbyangs kyis/ /lha chen zugs mnyes rin chen gser gyi ṭhi/ /gser mdog paṇa zhwa legs gsol bstan dang 'gro'i/ /skyabs dang mgon dbung dam pa'i gsol 'debs zhus/ /sbrel rong lam khar dred 'brong sbyang zhi'i rigs/ /nags kyi gshin rje kha gdangs lces brkyangs te//'jigs shing srog la rngams ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /mi rtag blo sbyong zab mo'i gdengs shig rnyed/ /brag dkar gnas rir rnar stan yid 'bab skya/ /dam chos rgyang klu ring mos chos pa'i tshogs/ /yid 'phrog chos zhus yum 'das gdung rus kyis/ /tsha tsha legs btab dge spyor rtsal du bton/ /lha ldan dbus phebs rgyal dbang yab sras dang / /khri chen ngag dbang snyan par grags ba'i sde'i/ /zhabs rdul sbyi bo'i rgyan bsten chos kyi char/ /bsam sbyor dag pa'i zhing sar tshul bzhin blangs/ /ra lug nor gyi srog 'phrog bshan pa'i las/ /zhib gzigs snying rjes jo bo'i zhabs stegs su/ /phyag 'tshal bro bor sha ri mi za zhes/ /chos bshad gzhan phan nyi ma'i rnam thar bskyangs//jo bor gser kong se 'bras dge gsum sder/ /mang ja'i mchod sgyin phyag skor sgrib sbyong dang / /spre'u lor tswa ri'i rong skor gter ston dang / /sā la 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen bar mjal/ /gong mo la rtsar rdo rje'i phag mo'i zhal/ /gsal gzigs dngos grub lung bstan chos kyi sder/ /bsam yas gtsug lag khang sogs ri khrod du/ /bstan 'gror phan ba'i legs bshad mang du brtsams/ /te se'i gangs la tshe 'di blos btang ba'i/ /skal ldan stong zag du mar las 'bras tshul/ /bslu med kun cab nges don chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin
24 gser gyi pha 'ong /bden stong zab rgyas glu ru blangs/ /gtad bzhi bud stegs thob dang rdo rje gsum/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun rigs dang dge sbyong gi /chos bzhi nyams bzhes lo gsum bcad rgya'i mthar//mi pham mtsho la gter bum rgya yis btab/ /sa rdor phyag zhabs rjes bzhag bal yul du//phebs skyel bya btang brgya zag du ma la/ /sna tshogs dab bshad mi rtag mgur ma'i glus//dad ba'i chu khol mig gi mtha' ru 'khyil/ /tshe thar phrog gi skyabs sbyin phyag yong rdzas//gser dngul g.yu byur nor rdzas mchis so cog /sa skya bsam yas bkras lhun dga' ldan gu /gser kong legs phul mchod sbyin sprin du dkrigs/ /mi la'i sgrub gnas pha yul rim brgyud kyi/ /shing kun bya rung kha shor mchod pa'i rten/ /phyag skor dge sbyor rnam 'phel brag sprul dang / /rje btsun don yod rdo rjer tshes zhus mjal/ /bkra shis sgang brgyud la phyi'i gangs sul pu/ tshe ring mched lnga'i zhal gzigs bdud 'dul phug gnas sgo gsar phyes lha khang rnying ba'i rigs/ /nyams gsos rgyal sras sprul pa'i thegs bam brtsams/ /byang sems chu dbar mkhan por gcod dbang dang / /blo sbyong dge ldan phyag chen chos zhus te/ /mngon shes thogs med nad kyis nyam thag tshor/ /dbugs dbyung byin rlabs grags pas sa chen 'gengs/ /gnya' nang zod phug dben gnas 'phel rgyas gling / /mang 'gyed bsnyen bkur gser zangs dngul gyi dngos/ /gnang sbyin bal bod 'dus tshogs khrom chen por/ /tshe yi dbang bskur chos bshad sdig rgyun bcad/ /bar gyi dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i char/ /pho grangs bco lngar chos ldan gyi/ /ris med grub mtha'i gnad kyi 'gangs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis dpal du bsgrubs/ /smad kyi mdo khams sgang gsum mpa /phebs bskul bzlog med dbyu gu'i mpi /snyan gyi rdza la grangs med pu /brdung pas brtan pa'i ting 'dzin dkrogs//dgra jag kun gsum snying gi bdud/ /rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs ral gri'i lces/ /bcom ldan gong 'og bar ma'i 'gror/ /skal bar 'tsham pa'i mchod sbyin yangs/ /legs bshad don gnyer mtha'adag gi /'dod gsol re ba'i shing rta'i snod/ /ris med grub pa'i mtha' kun gyi/ ldan chen nor bus gter du bkang / /rang byung brag ri'i bsil skyibs su/ /mkha' khyab
rtogs ba brjod ba'i rab byed/ 25'gro la dmigs gtad kyis/ /ting 'dzin bye bar 'jug ldang gi /sgyu ma'i rol rtsed bsam mi khyab/ /dad gtong 'byor ldan snyim ba'i mthil/ /kun khyab grags pas bskyod pa'i gdong //ladzum ba las 'ongs 'dod rgu'i nor/ /lhag med mchod ba'i zhing du spros/ /byang lam rim brgyud gdur tshogs mang / /spros zugam bkod ba 'byams klas mur/ /rma chu'i byang lho 'dzin ma'i char/ /phebs bsu lha las babs bas mtshon/ /gser rdzongs rong 'brog chos kyi lde//mtha' dag gtsug skyes 'bol ba'i gdan/ /zhabs sen 'khor po'i byin phab pas/ /dga' bde'i myong ba yid la lci/ /rma 'gram gser khang rdo rje brag /rten gsum nyi che'i 'dzum 'od can/ /lo ba'i gser yum ri'i snying bor/ /mjal dang sgom sgrub sems khrid phul/ /lcang skya rgya nag sprul ba'i skur/ /mjal 'azad 'jam dbyangs sprul ba'i gnas//rtse lnga'i ri bor mjal bzhed kyi/ /thugs 'dun mir ldog gros su mthun/ /rong bo'i tshogs dang gnyan zog chos kyi sder/ /yongs rjogs bltan ba'i mnga' bdag gser khang bas//thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i chos kyi gtam/ /gsang bde phyag na bzla'i dbang la gsan//sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med khyab gdal gyi/ /klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang / /mnyam gzhag rjes thob khang ba'i khyams yangs su/ /sna tshogs 'drin las nyi zer rdul du langs/ /lko phyogs chu gnyer 'gyur ba'i sgra dbyangs su/ /gdong bzhi chags ba dar ba'i rtsedga' las/ /byung ba ma yin ngag dbang lha yi sras/ /rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs glu ba'i zol gyis rgyu/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos tshul gnad kyi 'gangs/ /go ma'i glu tshig dbyangs kyi rgyud mangs su/ /rdung ba'i bya btang tshogs drug chags snang gi /rgya las zol 'di ci zhes kun ngo mtshar//mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel bcas pa yi/ /bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan 'dzin ba la/ /phyogs su lhung min 'phrin las kyi/ /'jug pa namo mkha'i mtha' la 'dzigs/ /rnyed bkur 'du 'dzi tshang tshing lu khu'i rgyud/ /'khor bar zhen log rno rgyun 'bar ba'i mes/ /lhag med bsregs pas yang dag lam gyi sgo/ /rgya chen phyes pa'i rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /ngan song dmyal ba'i zem skas 'dzugs pa yi/ /phyogs kun rku 'phrog sdig las snang med pu /longs spyod dmyal ba'i
26gser gyi bong /mgron du chas ba dag /snying rjes phyir ldog dbugs dbyung zad du med/ /re ba kun skong phur thogs sngags 'chang lde/ /ma lus ris med chos kyi dga' ston gu /legs sbyar mdzad 'phrin zla ba bsil ba'i 'od/ /gsar rnying utpal bzhad ba'i dbal du stoms/ /rgya chen mdo sngags dgongs zab nor bu'i gter/ /gdul bya'i rnar skyel gyong ba'i sems 'dul bar/ /snyan 'tshebs rdo rje'i klu yi dbyangs gcig gis/ /phyogs med grub mthar dad pa'i chu gter khol//e ma skal bzang blo ldan rnams/ /dka' sbyad med par thub pa'i srol/ /legs bshad nyan bzod thos 'dzin yang / /bsod nams bye bas bskrun min nam/ /las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i gtam/ /lung rigs dpe yi man ngag gis/ /smra ba zla med rdo rje'i gdangs/ /dpal stug mgrin ba'i rol mo bzhin/ /mtha' yas gdul bya'i khams dang rjes song ba'i/ /'chos skyob bcud du 'khyil ba mgur ma'i gtam/ /dus skya zong gis khugs min bstan pa'i srog /rgyal bstan tshe mthar ring ba'i rgyan du lham/ /dgung grangs don gcig lcags phag sa ga zla'i//dmar phyogs tshes bcu'i dus bar mdo sngags kyi/ /bgrang yas skal ldan gsung skyes rdul snyed kyi/ /'phral phugs phan bde'i mdzad 'phrin bsam las 'das//rgyal po'i rlangs tshang a bo skyabs kyi sar/ /sgrol ma'i thang zhes sna tshogs me tog gi /'ja' tshon sdug gur bkra ba'i zangs ldongs su/ /mi rtag sgyu ma'i mdzad ba bdag gir bzhes/ /mye ma nyin byed gzhon nu'i 'phros/ /nub rir 'chel tshe pasgro'i 'dzum/ /mun par 'chel ltar skye rgu'i gdong / /mya ngan mig chus smre ngag zlo/ /rgyal rnams gshegs byon smos ci 'tshal/ /dbugs kyi 'gyu ba za mor yang / /gtong len gzhan don sgyur mdzad na/ /skyo bas gdung 'bod byis pa'i sems/ /slar yang sprul ba'i rol gar gyis/ /'gro don dbag tu med ba'i gzur/ /rab 'byams zhing du rdul snyed kyi/ /grangs su ston la tshom ci yod/ /zhing 'di'i mkha' la sa 'dzin gyi/ /mgul bar 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i mdangs/ /bzhad ba'i snang ba kho nas kyang / /gdung mchod kun bzang 'phrul du spros/ /thos don dpen pa'i ri sul nyams dga'i gzhir/ /tshe dang snyoms par phyag bzhes rgya che'i gtam/ /tshig gi zeng bar srel ba'i legs
rtogs ba brjod ba'i rab byed/ 27byas kyang / /mgon de'i mdzad rnam byin mas kho nas rnyed/ /smra bsam brjod 'das gsang gsum nam mkha'i mtha'/ /ji bzhin brjod la spru ba'i lce thung yang / /cha shas lag zugar 'gul ba'i sug ris su/ /'gyu ba'i mchod sprin slo 'di'ang skal ba bzang / /'dir 'bad dge tshogs rab dkar mkha' yi glang / /dad pa'i gdengs spur rgyu ba'i char 'di yang / /skye ba'i phreng bar dam pa'i rnam thar gyis/ /rjes 'dzin gtong ba med pa'i zhing du 'phebs//zhes ris med mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan/ gangs can ri sul gyi rdo rje'i glu dbyangs mkhan 7skyabs mgon zhabs dkar pa tshogs drug rang grol gyi mdzad rnam go sla'i gtam du brjod pa rgya se'i me rtog ces ba 'di ni/ rong bo rgyal ba'i myu gur 'bod pas shar mar sal ba dge /gyi lo 1999 lo'i〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉'don zengs bzhi par bkod/

rtogs ba brjod ba'i rab byed/ 29'phashāsnra rnyitnayā spri lha shā mbi :lha /lha nā lha shā rdodzorlo ṣṭṛ ñdzaṃ rnying po 4rin/nyasze rgya/ /dmyal ba'i me dang snang ba'i dgra la yang / /shin tu zhi bsil bu gcig ltar dgongs shang / /ring nas snying rje'i goms ba mthar thogs pa'i/ /bdud kyi lde bcom lha de gangs ri'i mgon/ /rab 'byams zhing na bgrang yas rgyal kun gyi/ /spru bsam brjod med gaṅgā'i rdul snyed du/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad ngo mtshar gtam gyi gzhi/ /sna tshogs spro 'di snying rje'i 'phrul du sems/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung gtam gyi sbyor ba yis/ /rnam dkar legs byas rgya cher sdud do zhes/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i bslu med bden tshig gis/ /phyag rgyas btab pa rna ba'i gasdudas su babs/ /khyad par phyag na padmo bzhad pa'i lha/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro la thugs brtse'i gzhan dbang gis/ /gangs ldongs bstan srid rang dbang gtsang ma'i khrir/ /dbang bsgyur rtogs pa brjod la su mi gus/ /dregs ldan zil gnon gnyis med gsung ba'i ngag /khams gsum dbang sdud blo chen bzang po'i gter/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can mthar khyab mgon//dga' ldan pho brang tshad ma'i ston pa dran/ /'ga' zhig yin min yod med go bsgyur te/ /slo skur rdzun gyis lce bde'i brjod pa la/ /rtogs pa brjod dang rnam par thar ba zhes/ /'khyog po'i ngag la 'byams rnams rna ba khobs/ /g.yo sgyu'i gtam bral drang po'i ngag la nyan/ /phyogs lhung skyon bral blang dang dor bya'i gnas/ /rnon po'i blo yis 'byed pa'i shes ldan dag /dga' bas nyon la 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis 'ogangs/ /e ma 'phags mchog gru 'dzin nor bu'i mgon//gangs ri'i 'gro la snying rje'i mthu smin te/ /chos srid bka' lung gcig gis dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /ngo mtshar gtam snyan go sla'i ri mor 'phebs/ /'di skad thos so bslu med lung mang por/ /tshad mar lung bstan tshad ma'i rtags mtshan bcas/ /'grongs rgyas 'tsheng ba stag rtse'i rigs rgyud mpa /ngo mtshar rgyal ba 'khrungs pa'i gtam de snyan/ /dkar phyogs lha rnams kun
30 gser gyi pha bong /dga'i snying myos lte/ /mi 'gyur stobs rgyal dbang gi rgyal bo zhes/ /srung byin phyogs las rgyal ba'i shugs bzung bar/ /ma bzod bdud skya rigs dag cho nge 'debs/ /lo chung rgan po'i blo ldan rgya bod kyi/ /paṇa grub mkhas pa'i spyod la goms pa'i nyams/ /ma bslabs yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal ldan pas/ /phyogs kun dga' ba'i gtam gyis sgra gzhan 'phrogs/ /kun lha/pas patā ṭwāṃ nd+ra kau /rmi shārnyishā ṭwāṃ sra dzā da/ shā/ dī ༷/ sdusandha mi sdu/ stapa lha shā1 lung du bsgrags/ /gangs can 'dzin ma'i rgyan gcig lung rigs kyi/ /rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo ba'i dpal ldan pa'i/ /'bras dkar spungs pa'i tshal chen yid 'ong bar/ /lugs gnyis bkod pa sprin du dkrigs pas bsus/ /ka ri ka nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i bar/ /bshad dang sgrub ba'i thub bstan 'dzin pa'i gzhi/ /bshes gnyen bsnyen dang sdom khrims 'dzin ba la/ /lhan skyes gsang ba'i rnam thar bsam mi khyab/ /gangs can mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / /khri chen 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog chos 'phel sogs/ /dngos grub kun 'byung lam gyi rtsabar gzigs//'phral sbyar klog dang phar tshad gzhung lugs la/ /go rigs zung 'brel sbyi mtha'i dbyad pa yis/ /brgal brtag rtsod pa'i rigs pa phra mo'i gnad/ /tshegs med mkhyen pa'i sku yon blos mi dpog /mi tshe rtsod par stoms pa'i zogs dag kyang / /bslab la ma bstos kun mkhyen 'di ci zhes/ /rgyu 'bras phra mor tshom par mi 'tshal ces/ /tsan dan skyon pas lhan skyes dri bzang ngom/ /phyogs glang chos grags tshad ma'i gsang tshig kun/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i dgongs 'grel bstan bcos kyi/ /mig zur rnon pos rjed pa'i lung rigs la/ /mkhas ba'i mkhas ba kun kyang lan gyis dbul/ /gnyis med gsung ba don kun grub pa'i mdo'i/ /sras don mngon par rtogs pa'i gter chen po/ /mi pham gzhung lugs dngos brgyad don bdun cur/ /hril gyis dril ba'i lde mig rtsod bas rnyed/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs ma yal ba'i/ /yi dam lhag lha srung ma'i bka' dbang dang / /rjes gnang gsan bzhes bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan du/ /bskyangs pas

rtogasapabarjod pa'i rab byed/ 43'bru/ /khor yug byur bur dkrigs pa'i ri bo 'dir/ /zhe dul bag yod chos spyod sdom brtson khyu/ /dgag sgrub lung rigs tshad mas mgrin pa mtshes/ /mdo sngags bka' bstan thogs med spru ba'i ngag /rmad byung 'dab brgya grol ba'i zil dngar rer/ /tshangs sras rig pa gakhyil ba'i kun rig gi /gser ri'i gral dbung bstan pa'i rgyan du bsgrigs/ /chos don snying gi bcud du spel ba yi/ /rgyud dus mngon byang sman pa'i sde mtha' dag /bla gos byu ru'i snye ma bzhad ba can/ /ljags ldan rig pa ston zla'i dpal du 'phel/ /rmad byung zeg chen thabs shes yon tan gyi/ /zab rgyas chu bo gcig tu 'khyil ba'i gzhir/ /dge ldan rang bstan dar zhing rgyas ba'i gling / /phyogs las rnam bar rgyal ba'i grags dkar stan/ /rnam pa de lta'i dbang rgyug skra zeng gis/ /mchod bkur rgyan gyi tshemo'i zla ba ni/ /mdo sngags zung 'jug rnal 'byor mthar pyin pa'i/ /bdag gi yab gcig khyab bdag bla mar nges/ /bstan 'gro'i mgon 'di byis ba'i dus nas kyang / /dam ba'i rang rtags rab gsal nyi ma'i byin/ /mnyam zla med bas kha kyā'i grub chen bas/ /shar gtong yang srid lnga par bden tshig bsgrags//sngon goms nges 'byung kun gsal dag pa'i mkhar/ /blo bzang bstan pa mchog gi nang mdzod che/ /yang dag sdom khrims zla dkar nor bu'i 'od/ /yon tan rgya mtshor 'phel ba'i /rnyipa spri shār/ shā/ pas zlo /tsho ri~Xs po'i che/ga gāng ba rmo (( shā /shā /mi ༷gas 3) // dag bas bsten pa'i lam bzang bas/ /blo bzang ston pa'i chos kun zugs su chud/ /khyad bar 'jigs med bzhi ldan don dam gyi/ /chos tshul rmad byung rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i gter//gang las rnam daphyod gser gyi skyogs bzang bos/ /'khrul bral lta ba'i mchod yon bcad du 'thungs/ /gzhan yang spru ba'i dbang phyug shes rab kyi/ /rgya mtsho'i klong du brdol ba'i paṇḍi ta//legs tshogs rtsabar bsnyen ba'i dngos grub tu/ /'phags bod mkhas pa'i bzhed dgongs ma lus gzigs/ /bgrang bya'i mchod sdong ches cher phra na yang / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa phan bde'i snying po can/ /spel la zla med dbag bsam smon pa 'di/ /ci zhes 'jig rten gling brjod

46gser gyi pha 'ongadtshangs pa'i dbyangs su bsgrags/ /tha dad rigs kyi yid dbang sa 'dzin rtser/ /mdza' mthun gser zam sbrel ba'i lam bzang bo/ /'bral yun bde la sbyor ba rgyal ba'i bstan/ /spel ba'i ñdza gser gyi 'ong /ma byin len byed par/ /dun ma'i ming gi brjod pa slob mi dgos/ /mngon sum mig gis mthong bzhin gzhan gyi nor/ /btsan gyis 'phrog pa jag pa'i las su rtsi/ /kun jag ngan ba'i ming la mi 'phrod cing / /g.yo thabs sgyu ma 'phrul gyi go dbang gis/ /lkog gyur snyog po'i nor gyi mdzod 'dzin par/ /ngo mtshar cho lo'i mtshan snyan ci zhig sbyin/ /nor gyis nyam chung mkhas ba che rnams kyang / /nor gyis mtho ba'i glen pa'i ngor lta zhing / /nor bu'i rgyug bdag klad med rkyal stong tshos/ /mkhas pa g.yog tu bkol la zhe re pham/ /zas kyis rtogs skom sel ba nor gyi ched/ /gos kyis tsha grang skyob pa'ang nor gyi phyir/ /dbang lngas rtsol ba bgyid ba'ang nor gyi ched//mdor na nor gyis 'jig rten rdul du dkrigs/ /byis pas ka kha slob pa mi che'i ched//pha mas byis pa gnyor ba khyim gyi don/ /pha ma byis pa'i gces skyong 'brel ba yang / /rgyu dang nor gyi dra ba'i khe tshong nyid/ /slob mas dge rgan bsten pa rig pa'i don/ /rgan gyi slob mar dpe khrid phogs kyi ched/ /gnyis gas 'bad pas btsal ba'i rig pa yang / /nor lha'i bu yi rim gro 'ba' zhig nyid/ /'brog pas nas rtsod pa zog gi don/ /zhing pas sa chu gnyer ba 'bru yi ched/ /tshong bas 'dur rgyugs kun gyi kha sha'i tshig /rgyu dang nor gyi snyog po'i g.yang 'bod nyid/ /gsar bus rtsom yig spel ba yon gyi ched/ /rgan pas 'khor g.yog skyong ba 'brel ba'i don/ /'brel ba 'brel ba'i dra ba sgor la bcol/ /sgor sgya ched du lajog rten gtor lor pa'or/ /nor ldan tshong pa'i grwa par kun kyang smon/ /grwa rkyang dge ba'i bshes la'ang rtsis su med/ /shes yon med kyang nor dang ldan gyur na/ /bla ma mkhas pa ra bkur la ze mi 'tshol ba bu tsha'i don/ /bla mas 'bul sdud mdzad pa dgon pa'i ched/ /grwa bas dkar thigs slong ba rten bzhengs don/ /zhe phugs re ba'i bang ba nor la zug /btsan pos bka' gnyan bkrams pa nor gyi ched/ snyan rtsom ñtsha rab byed/ 65grangs mang ba nor gyi don/ /sdug yus sme ngag rmo ba'ang nor gyis mnar/ /rang gzhan ris su gcod pa rtsod pa'i sgo/ /chags snang rtsaba'i sa bon 'dod pas bslus/ /'dod pas dbang med g.yo ba'i lus ngag gi /nor gyi don la sna tshogs rol rtsed 'gyed/ /mthon pos dman par brnyas ba nor gyis khongs/ /dman pas zhum zhing rtsiba'ang nor gyis dbul/ /mtho dman mi yi mtshams 'byed nor la zug /nor lha'i bu yi sprul ba bsam mi khyab/ /nor gyis phyug na kun gyis nis su byed/ /nor ldan bu la 'di pyi'i chos kyang 'byor/ /rin chen nor la bla ma lha yang mnyes/ /nor lha'i rgyal por phyag mi 'tshal ba su/ /rdzas 'phrul rig pa 'gran pa nor gyi ched/ /bzo zhing dmag don rgya bskyed nor gyi don/ /tshan rig sna tshogs spel ba'ang nor la re/ /nor gyi don la sna tshogs gzhung lugs dar/ /rgyal khab phan tshun 'khrag pa nor gyi ched//grub mtha'i gzhung lugs dgag sgrub la rgya'i don/ /rgyal don mngon lkog brtan srung 'bangs kyi ched/ /mtha' dag nor gyi lha dga'i 'cham re steg /sna tshogs 'dzugs sgrun las don srid kyi don/ /srid kyi dmigs 'dun nor gyi snying por bcol/ /kun gyi nor phyir 'dod pa mtsho ltar brdol//mye ma 'jig rten 'jig pa'i mtha' la phyogs/ /rgyu nor bu mos 'dod pa'i khyo btsal yang / /'dod ba'i snyi mos mi 'dod bzhin mnar bas/ /rgyu nor bde ba'i 'brel thag mi 'dod bzhin/ /gcod pa'i rtsab 'dod pa'i mda' la thug /rab 'byams zhing gi 'jig rten khang mig rer/ /nor la re dogs dug gi kha rlangs kyis/ /mnar ba'i nad kyi gcig mchog sman gyi gter/ /'doms dang ston pa de la lha zhes bsngags/ /mdor na thams cad rtsod pa'i bang 'gran nas/ /rang rang bde ba'i don la nor sgrub kyang / /'dod pa'i 'gong bos rang sems bde ba'i skyed/ /rang srid dgra ltar 'joms pa yi re mug /nor la re ba'i rtsab 'dod pas gdung / /'dod pa'i a ma bdag 'dzin rgyal mos byed/ /de slad khams gsum rigs drug skye gnas bzhi'i/ /gakhor skyod rgyal khrims 'jig tshogs lta bas 'byed/ /bde 'joms rgud pa'i btson du sbyor byed pa'i/ /lta ba'i dgra tshogs gzhom la thabs mkhas pa'i/ /gzhung lugs ston

de rnyed kyang / /kha bshad stong bar 'ur ba'i mgo skor gyis bslus nas/ /sgor mo'i bdag 'dzin brdol ba'i dge bshes kyang yod skad/ /shes bya gzhi lngas bcings pa chos mngon pa'i rnam grangs/ /dka' sbyad 'bad pas sbyangs nas ka kha ltar byang yang / /gyi rgyal 'phrul bzo rig pa'i mngon sum de mthong nas/ /mdzod kyi ming brdas ma phan dbul ba yang go yong / /'dul ba'i bcas mtshams zhib cha ma de/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med rim lnga'i bzod lam de bor nas/ /sgor mo'i dkyil 'khor sgom ba mang dag cig mthong song / /pyi nang gang yin mi shes hin du ba'i rigs la/ /sgom sngags rdzas ma 'tshal pa'i ngo mtshar gyi grub rtags/ /rig byed sgang gis bsnyad pa'i gtam rgyud kyi mi sna//ri khrod khrom du bzhugs ba kha shas kyang 'dug go/ /rnal 'gyor dpa' bo pho mo'i dga' ston gyi gro ra/ /nyer bzhi'i yul dang sum cu rtsaganyis kyi gnas sogs/ /ngo mtshar zhing du grags pa'i 'gangs chen gyi grub gnas/ /ñtsha rol grub mthas bzung pa'i rong chen du mjal song //'phags ba'i yul du grags pa'i krong khyer drug zhes bar/ /deng sang gyi nang skye rgu'i zang zing gi 'du 'dod/ /mi tshad brgal ba'i zog mkhar grog ma yis bskor bzhin/ /tshong zog gcal du bkram pa'i 'du tshogs su che'o/ /nga tshos lha ru bkur ba rgya gar ba'i rigs kyis/ /nog dang lkog shal 'dus ba'i ba lang la brtsis bas/ /bod kyi then bar lta ba 'phags yul gyi lha de/ /ba lang gcig bu'i steng gi gnas lugs gnyis mthong song / /〈sna chu ta li'i shing dang lo 'khum kyis nyal ba'i/ /mdo dang gleng gzhir 'byung ba'i skye dngos kyi rigs dang //nasngon mi gtsang 'dor dang sa bsko sogs bcas pa/ /'dul khrims yul dus bstun pa'i gnas lugs dag mthong song / /gyi nang gang yin shes dka'i rgyud lde yi rnam grangs/ /legs sbyar lha yis skad can glegs bam gyi phung po/ /hin bod sus kyang mi shes gna' rdzas kyi rig gnas/ /zab dka'i phyag rgyas btab pa mang dag cig yod skad/ /grong gseb kher khyim ri mgo'i rmog 'od dang bzod lam/ /stabs bde zhi lam 'tsho ba'i lhang 'jags de mthong zhing //dgun yang rdzo ljang shing tog sna tshogs kyi yul 148gser gyi pha bong]zas gtsang gi sras bo/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis grub chen brgyad cu sogs byon nas/ /byin rlabs rus su zhugs pa'i gān nyi rjes bzhag pa'i/ /ya rabs srol bzang dar ba'i mi rigs 'dir dga' 'o/ /thos don snying nas khol ba'i ri khrod kyi bya btang / /mi tshe chos su bskyal ba'i rnal 'byor ba mang po/ /nyin mtshan sgom gyis 'da' ba don ldan gyi chos pa/ /hin bod sgyi gling ris med yi rang gi gnas so/ /rnam sras bang mdzod 'dzin ba dad ldan gyi snyog pos//rten gsum bzhengs dang chos ba yul gyar gyi mi la/ /gtong ba'i sgo 'phar phyes pa blo yul las 'das ba'i/ /mgon med zas sbyin mang pos thams cad kun bde'o/ /slob grwa'i 'gro stangs chags pa'i dgon khag gi bzhengs bkod/ /sa dge bka' rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi gzhung lugs/ /skad rigs du mas spru ba gzhon skyes skya mkhas pa/ /gcig las gcig lhag bstan srid gdung ladzin du che'o/ /ladzam gling sbyi nor rigs kun khyab bdag gi nor bu//phyag na paca'i byams brtse lhar shar gyi sku gzugs/ /bsgras rgud ci yang mi mnga' ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa/ /bslu med skye rgu'i mgon du mdzad 'phrin rang rgyas so/ /bdag kyang brtse bas zhags pas lhod med du bzung nas/ /nang sbyar bka' slob dgyes zhal 'ja' gur gyi klong mpa/sku sger zhabs zhu'i gral mthar bkod khyab rang mdzad pa/ /bka' drin gzhal thabs bral ba'i skal ba de bzang ngo //'on kyang lho phyogs chos kyi grong khyer du 'gro ba/ /snying gi mthil du yod pa'i dam bca' rang yin bas/ /ring min thams cad mkhyen pas dgongs na'ol zhig byung na/ /grwa sar mdo sngags chos rgyun 'tshol ba la gas 'gro/ /zas chu gnam gshis gang sa ci thad kyi cha skyen//sgyu lus g.yar po'i rten la mi 'phrod pa med pas/ /'du bral snying po med la dgongs bzhes shig gnang nas/ /mkhan bu phran gyi phyogs la zugs khur rang lhod chog /'on kyang yun ring 'grogs nas bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa'i/ /nya gang zla ba'i rjes 'gro brtsesems gyi mdud ba/ /'di dang phyi ma'i mthar yang g.yung drung gi ris su/ /nam yang lhod pa med pa'i thugs rjes re gzigs shig /thub bstan sbyi dang gser rdzongs bshad lhab skya bstan pa/ /ji ltar

'grin yig gi rab byed/ 151zhu 'phrin dge legs nyi ma 'dren pa'i skya rengs/ko'u lde dgon zlo/sa ttinypha // snordoyā 'a/sna ༵ /hā ndha ston sras dkon mchog mtshosbyiji༄rgyargya/ /rgyal kun ye shes 'od lnga 'bar ba'i rdul/ /rla khri'i me rtog 'dzum pa'i lang tsho la//rnam bkra kun shes dngos grub stsol ba'i lha/ /snying gi khri la 'bral ba med gyur cig /ka dag gdod ma'i rang zhal dkon ba'i mchog /mngon sum lta ba'i tsho ga rmad byung gang / /kun bzang legs bshad 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /rig ba'i dbal du dge ba gang zhabs su/ /ring nas las 'brel zhags pas dam bzung ste/ /gcig mthun mdza' ba'i snying po thub pa'i srol//thos bsam ral ba'i rgyan du 'phel ba'i g.yang / /rnam krol thabs su re ba de yis gleng //ngo mtshar rten 'byung legs tshogs rdzogs pa'am/ /dkar phyogs lha yis byin gyis rlabs sam ci/ /gnyid kyi ting 'dzin gsal ba'i rmi lam drar/ /bstan la dge ba'i 'phel gtam bya bas bskul/ /gna' bo'i dus nas sā la'i sman rdzongs 'dir/ /thugs bskyed mthun pa'i rlung gis bskul ba yis/ /bshad sgrub lag rjes bsung zhim 'thul ba'i ngad/ /rogs ldan sprin du spros ba bsam mi lang / /sa dge dar rnying mkhas grub lu gu rgyud/ /mu tig tsheng ba'i dpal du bstar ba'i 'dzum/ /pha rjes bu yis zin pa'i rnam thar klong / /bsam gyin mos gus rlabs brgya dbang med 'phyo/ /khyad par rgya bod mkhas grub zugs kyi bcud/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud rje'i dgongs pa'i gnad/ /kun mkhyen bstan la lta ba'i legs bshad migmthong tshe slobs ba'i rang shugs bag la zha /gser grongs 'dir yang thub bstan phan bde'i phrog phyag na bzla'i 'phrin las nyin byed kyis/ /rgud pa'i mun sel dpag bsam me tog tu//bskyed ba'i bka' drin lhun po'i tshad du rogs/ /deng yang zhing 'dir bsod nams mkha' yi klong / /brdol ba'i bstan 'dzin sna tshogs bkod ba'i gzugs/ /gcig tu ma nges sgyu ma'i
152gser gyi pha bong /dra ba ru/ /'byams pa'i snang ba che ba'i 'dzum du gsal/ /'on kyang dus 'dir gyi rol srid 'byor gyi/ /phun tshogs 'dod chung dka' shub snying ga la/ /mtshon du no ba'i rang mtshang sgyu ma'i rdzas/ /nyin bzhin bdo bas phyogs kun nongs par byas//de bas lhan cig 'grogs pa'i rab byung sde/ /chen por rlom pa phal kyang 'dod yon gyi//mi zad 'phrul zhags gzer gnon rgyas btab pas/ /gyi ma'i las 'bras sems pa re gnyis tsam/ /mee 'di'i rnyed bkur sdud pa'i g.yo thabs kyis/ /phal la rje bor dril bsgrags rin chen khrir/ /bkur ba'i wa skyes lhar ku'i mig 'phrul gyis/ /sa chen zin ba'i tshul 'dir yid rab skyo/ /phan bde'i rtsalag rgyal bstan rin chen zhes/ /lta ba snyigs mas bslad pa'i yang mtha' 'dir/ /da gdod bstan ba su zhig 'dzin 'gyur zhes/ /'o dod byas kyang su zhig gsan bar 'gyur/ /de'i pyir rigs kyi bu khyod zugs bskyed kyi/ /mkhyen rtogs zab bsnang kun bzang dge ba'i dbal/ /mthong bas bstan ba'i khur chen 'degs pa'i rtsal/ /gcig tu sgrim pa'i re ba khyod la 'cha'/ /mi rabs du mar lung rtogs nor bu'i gdugs/ /'dzin ba'i dbung ba rab badring sprul ba'i skus/ /bdag gir bzung ba'i rus rgyud ngo mtshar bar/ /rgyal kun bzod ba gcig gis khyod dbang bskur/ /zhing 'dir mi yi rigs su gakhungs na yang / /rmad byung sku yi skye mched lha yi gzugs/ /mtha' dag 'gro la mthong rgyol me rtog tu/ /'dzum ba'i gsang ba 'di yang bsam mi khyab/ /sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar ma lus kun/ /rjes 'jug bzod pa gcig pa'i gzhung lam gu /gsungs pyir na tshod za mo'i skabs nas kyang / /gcig tu gzhol ba'i tsho ga lhod mi 'tshal/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i mkhas bya'i gnas/ /dbag yas kun gsal pha mtha'i rjes song ba/ /gus rtag brtson bas dbyad 'jog sgom gcig tu//bsten ba'i thabs tshul rgyan gyi dwangs mar soms/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor lam gyi srog shing pu/bkur la tshogs bsags sgrib spyong man ngag gi /gzhung chen mdo dang sngags la bshad sgrub gnyis/ /zung du 'jug 'di zugs kyi dkyil du dgongs/ /thos bral ri sul 'grim ba'i dka' thub dang / /tshig rkyang zos bsam stong 'ur mkhas rlom gnyis/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam
'grin yig gi rab byed/ 153las gol bas na/ /ngal ba 'ba' zhig snying por 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /de phyir thos bsam sgom sgrub dang / /lung rtogs bshad sgrub ma lus pa/ /phan tshun 'gal med krogs khyer gyi/ /gdams pa rgya mtsho'i phud du bzhes/ /dus kyi dmod bas bslus pa yi/ /bstan dang de 'dzin gzugs brnyan la/ /zugs bskyed sgobs pa brtan po'i shugs/ /g.yo med nam mkha'i mtha' la skyongs//gangs kyi ri bo gcig nyid las/ /chu klung brgya grag 'bab pa lta'i/ /sna tshogs grub mtha' rgyas bsdus kun/ /dgongs pa gcig tu hril gyis dril/ /khyad par bsngags 'os yon tan bye ba'i gter/ /'don dang ston la dbang 'byor dam pa'i mgon/ /yab rje bla mas gang gsungs gdams ba'i bka'/ /kun mkhyen rig pa sgrub pa'i thabs su dgongs/ /rmad byung zag med bde dga' mngar ba'i ro/ /gang bsam yid bzhin 'byung ba kun gyi sgo/ /bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin mdzes ma'i longs/ /thugs la dga' ston rogs pa'i dpal du khugs//blang dor 'jug ldog mun sel nyin byed che/ /kun 'byung rtsab thos bsam yin no zhes/ /sngon byon mkhas grub ma lus mgrin gcig tu/ /bsngags pa rnal 'byor gdams pa'i mthil du dgongs/ /bstan pa'i nang mdzod lung rigs bye ba'i gter/ /chig dril slob gnyer rdo rje'i lde mig gis/ /rnam mang 'akro la zugs rje gzigs pa'i mas/ /ma g.yel sgo brgyar 'byed ba'i rnam thar ston/ /khyad par sna tshogs rin chen ri rab ltar/ /spungs kyang mi khugs mes po'i ring bsrel mpa /gces rgu'i snying po sgom khrid nyams rtogs kyi/ /gdams pa 'tshol ba'i bhyor ba nyams su longs/ /legs byas 'o ma'i chu gter las 'khrungs pa'i/ /bstan 'gror sman ba'i sgyu lus padma'i kron/ /ston mtshan zla ba rgyas pa'i lang tsho ltar/ /bskal brgyar rab gsal mdzad 'phrin rgyas gyur cig /phyi 'og 1994 78 tshes 17 la/
'dzin yigagi rab byed/ 155zhu 'phrin g.yas 'khyil dung gi rang sgra/yab rje bla ma mchog shar phyogs rgyal khab tu bzhugs skabs 'phrin du phul ba/'a zhi ca༄7/ /blo bzang chub pa'i bshad sgrub gdams pa'i mdzod/ /rang gir spyod ba mi yi 'jam dbal dbyangs/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i lang tshor 'phel ba'i mgon/ /gang zhabs grib bsil dge mtshan 'bar ba'i drung / /ma dag snang ba 'byams klas dud ba'i sprin/ /kun gzhi'i mkha' la dkrigs pa'i ljang mthug kyang / /mgon po gang la yid ches dad pa'i mdangs/ /brgya phrag nyi ma'i 'od du shar ba des/ /sngon dus tshad ma'i ston pa blo bzang grags/ /tsong kha'i bya khyung mchod rten rnam dag drung / /rab byung thub bstan nyi zla'i 'od dkar du/ /rgyas par byas so snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir/ /dben gnas drang srong chen bo'i gdan sa ru/ /mdo sngags bshad sgrub pha rol phyin ba yi/ /sngon med shub pa mchog gi rgyal tshab 'di/ /su zhes tshom par mi 'tshal bdag gi mgon/ /byang sems nam mkha'i gter mdzod phul byung zhabs/ /dpal ldan lta ba'i klong zab klu sgrub zugs/ /chig dril sgyu ma'i rnam rol bdag gi skyabs/ /dkyil pa'or rgya mtsho'i dbus na mngon bar 'phags/ /mtha' dag dregs ldan gtsug gi rgyan gyur kyang / /dman la brtse gzigs zhags pas mi 'dor bas/ /gsang gsum mdzad bzang cha shas za mo yang / /gzhan pha na gcig tu lhun grub bsam las 'das/ /bslab gsum dkyil lubor nya rgyas zla ba'i dpal/ /mdo sngags phyogs med gsal ba'i 'od dkar gyis/ /kun gzigs paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas mchog /thugs 'phyog bsngags brjod ku mud tshom bur bzhad/ /zab rgyas gnyis tshogs mdo rgyud ston pa'i gzhung / /smra la khyod gcig ston pa bzhin gyur bas/ /chen po'i tha snyad 'chang ba'i rgyal sras mang / /zhing 'dir gab pa'i brtul zhugs dbang med byin/ /gsang gsum dpal stug grub pa'i dri bzangs kyis/ /9 nang rigs skya gdul bya rgya mtsho'i sprin/ /zhags pa med par bcings pa'i dge legs 'dis/ /phyogs dus

legs brtsegs pa'i skyed tshal yangs/ /der 'khrangs nor bu'i dpag bsam shing / /mdo sngags bshad sgrub me rtog gis/ /rab ma sa dngos grub 'dod 'khro'i dbang / /mya ngan gdung sel byed po'i mchog /dus mthar snyigs ma'i rang mtshang dang 'grogs pa'i/ /chen po'i tha snyad 'chang ba ma lus pa'i/ /sbyi gtsug zhabs sen dgod ba'i gar stegs su/ /rang dbang spyod pa'i mdzad rnam blo las 'das/ /na tshod ches za thog ma'i skabs nas kyang / /bla med sprul ba'i rnam thar lhur bzhes te/ /rgyal rnams bzod ba gcig ba'i lam rim du/ /ma bskul ngang gis 'jug ba'i mdzad sgo yangs/ /lha gcig ston ba'i bka' gsung tshad ma ru// don gnyis tshad mar sgrub pa'i cos bsam sgom/ /bslab gsum tshad ma'i nyams bzhes rmad byung gis/ /sku bzhi tshad mar bzhes pa'i rnam thar zab brtsechen dri bzhon gyis bskyod 'phrin las kyi/ /gcig tu gzhan phan 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpyid/ /phan bde'i bsung zhim ma la ya rlung gis/ /phyogs skya skal ldan bung ba mgron du 'bod/ /dbu ma'i lta bar nyer 'brel rdo rje'i zeg /lasam mgon bla ma'i zugs gsang nor bu'i mdzod//rgya cher legs phye'i mdzad bzang dbyar gyi rnga/ /phyogs su brdung ba'i tshangs dbyangs srid zhi'i rgyan/ /bka' bod lnga dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /bshad dang sgrub pas 'dzin pa la/ /phyogs las rnam bar rgyal ba'i lde/ /khyod gcig bstan 'gro'i mgon skyabs nyid/ /mkhas bya ma lus mkhyen rab kyi/ /me long gtsang mar rab gsal bas/ /'od rgya yul gru mtha'adag par/ /slob mar 'dud ba'i tshad mi dbog kun yid dad gsum glang bo'i gtsug /bden gsung tshad ma'i dbang sdud kyi/ /zhags bas dbang med yongs bsnams ba'i/ /'phrin las dam ba'i dbal du bsdebs/ /rgyal kun gsang ba'i bcud 'khyil ba'i/ /lhun grub dag gtsang gang gā'i rgyun//
'brinayig gi rab byed/ 161mdzad bzang bdud rtsi'i ro bro ba/ /dad gsum myu gu gso ba'i rgyan/ /'di na bka' dang dgongs 'grel lung rigs kyi/ /thos rkyang rnam g.yeng 'jig rten sgyu ma'i blos/ /bslad pas chos sems rgyab bsnol dmyal ba'i mgron/ /mgon khyod snying rje'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i gnas/ /3 ru mi yi lus thob chos cos kyang / /thog med 'khor bar 'dres pa'i rnam shes go /zin med 'dir snang sgyu ma'i dbang gyur bas/ /zugs rjes gzigs pa'i re ba ma bslu zhig /dus kyi snyigs mas sa chen nongs byas pas/ /nges don bstan 'dzin mchog sprul shin tu dkon/ /na tshod rgas pa phal cher zhing gzhan gshegs/ /sprul sku gzhon nu phal cher dus kyis nongs/ /ser gzugs grangs kyis 'phel kha dar ches kyang / /3 rol skyen gyis bslus pa bgrang las 'das/ /deng rabs shes yon can rnams dmar bos bslus//gna' bo'i srol rgyun 'dzin rnams mgo bo mkhregs/ /de slad khyab bdag dang po'i mgon po khyod/ /ston pa'i bstan la ston ba bzhin gyur bas/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rgya mtsho'i gtso bo ru/ /rtag brtan zhabs zung g.yo ba med gyur cig /gser krongs 'dis mtshon khyod byin kho na'i mthur/ /rtse gcig re ba'i mig zung lhod med pa'i/ /nyam thag bstan 'gro'i ngang tshul rjes dgongs la/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i mee dbal 'gro la ston/ /rmad byung bgrang yas legs byas kyis bskrun pa'i/ /mi 'gyur zhabs zung dge legs spungs pa'i rgyan/ /chos kyi gshor lo'i char 'phebs rdo rje'i sku/ /lham me lhan nee lhang nger bzhugs gyur cig /phyi lo 1996 zla 1 tshes 25 nyin rma lho rgyud kyi chos lde chen po rong bo bden chen chos 'khor gling nas gus slob pa blo bzang snyan grags kyi gus pa bla na med pas phul/

1stogaser 9 pha bong /gral dpung bsgrigs pa mtha' dag las/ /rnam par rgyal ba bdag gi bshes/ /na tshod shin tu phra mo'i dus nas kyang / /sngon goms legs byas chu gter brdol ba'i mtsho/ /'gog med phyed khyod 'dra nyin skar tsam/ /cher snyigs smag rum gakhor lo 'bum zag bcu/ /brtsegs pa'i sbrubs na lung rtogs 'od dkar can/ /dus kyi mun pa sel ba'i byed pa bor/ /lhun gyis grub ba khyod gzhan khyod brgya phrag 'bad bas nyer bsgrubs pa'i/ /rgyud sne rnam bzhi'i legs bshad bdud ji'i sman/ /bdag yid gdung ba sel ba'i nyer 'tsho ru/ /sgyin la re ba brtsebs ma bslu zhig /dus 'dir mdo sngags 'azin yig gi rab byed/ 165nta/ /gang 'tsham legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed gyur cig /'di na 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i rang bstan la/ /bgyi 'os nyan bshad las la cher mos kyang / /thog med dus nas 'dris ches kun slongs mas/ /gzhan dbang gyur phyir kun slong smon yul tsam/ /gser dngul lhun por brtsegs kyang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /dpen sa snyan brgyud man ngag zhal shes bcas/ /ci 'dod rna ba'i rgyan du bstsal ba'i drin/ /ñtsha lam na yang dran pa'i thal mo sbyor/ /nyi zla mkha' la bzod pa ma 'gags pa/ /de srid khyod zhabs mi shigs rdo rje'i rgya/ /lhod med bgrang yas skal ldan 'gro ba'i gtsug /rab mdzes dge legs mchog gi dngos grub zhu/ /ring min khyod zhabs padma 'dzum pa'i dpal/ /'dren byed bung ba'i nyer 'tshor legs smin lte/ /zab rgyas legs bshad sbrang ji'i dga' ston 'bum/ /dngos grub mchog tu rgyas pa'i dbal du zhu/ /pha gcig blo bzang rgyal ba'i rang bstan gdugs/ /bshad sgrub dpung ba gtum pos 'degs pa la/ /deng nas skye ba kun tu mgon khyod dang / /'bral med zhal bzhes gsung 'phrin bdag la stsol//ces 9 'og 1997 zla 1 tshes 15 la rgya nag gi rgyal sa pe can gyi spung zas mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag sbyi khyab chab srid dmag sgar chen mo'i 'gron khang du/ 'jigs med rgyal ba mchog gi gdung 'tshob 7skyabs mchog shar gdong rin po che'i sku gam du zhi lhag gi khrid dang / spyod 'jug gzhan yang dbang lung du ma'i bka' drin nod bzhin bla ma rin bo cher zhabs zhu sgrub pa'i dus su yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo 7rje blo gsal rgya mtsho'i bka' drin dran bzhin gakhos chung ba blo bzang snyan grags su 'bod pas gus pas phul//
thol byung gi mgur/ ge na chas༄rgya8/ /phyogs dus gsum rgyal ba'i snying rje'i bdag /phyag bgrang phreng padma dkar pos mdzes/ /sgos gangs can 'gro la las 'brel can/ /zugs snying rjes gang ba spyan ras gzigs/ /zhing rab 'byams bkod pa dpag med na/ /tshul mi gcig sprul ba'i rol gar mkhan/ /skabs la lar rgyal po'i dbang thang 'dzin/ /mtshams lan rer bya btang ri khrod pa//skabs 'ga' zhig mkhas dang dge ba'i bshes/ /chos lam rim 'chad pa'i po to ba/ /dus deng sang mdo smad bya khung sga /mkhas grub pa gnyis ldan bdag gi yab/ /chos kun mkhyen bstan dang 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bod rgya sog gdul bya'i gabor gyis bskor/ /phyogs mkhas rgu'i gtsug na lham me ba'i/ /rje blo bzang grags pa'i gdan sa ba/ /bus rgyang ring 'phags pa'i yul rongs nas// sems nye ba'i glu skad da ma dig /mig mchi mas gang ba sha ra ra//lag thal mo gtsug na ldem se ldem/ /pha bla ma'i bskyod ba yang ngam kye/ /gsung brtse ba'i gdangs la 'gags med dam/ /thugs bsgras skyon med par gsal lags sam/ /bu brtse bas zhags pas ma dor ram/ /phran mgon khyod zugs rje'i bka' drin dang / /rdzas srung byin 'khor po'i go khrab kyis/ /gang ci bsam 'dod pa lhun grub nye/ /lha phyag na pacha'i zhabs la gtugs/ /sems snang ba phro ba'i gzhal yas su/ /gsung nang sbyar bka' mol sgyug pa'i gtam/ /pha bla ma'i bu ro'i drin gyis thob/ /gsung bka' 'bum sdud pa'i lung bstan mdzad//zla kha shas gang nus ci 'grub kyis/ /gangs ra bas bskor ba'i bstan dang 'gror//gsung rin chen nor bu lhu bsgrigs kyis/ /bka'i glegs bam bzo ba'i tshogs gsog byed//rje rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs pa'i/ /zhing rmad byung 'phags pa 'i yul rongs na/ /bod nyam thag 'gro ba'i dbugs dgrang mkhan/ /gsung 'phrin las 'dzam gling mtha' la khyab/ /pha bla ma'i dgongs bzhed de dang gcig /'brom rab byung sprul pa'i gsung tshul gnyis/ /bu'i
'phrinayig gi rabajed/ 169kyi dka' 'o skad/ /rje bla mas zos bsam nyams bzhes rnams/ /phyogs kun tu bstan ba rgyas pa'i phyir/ /tshe hril bor 'bad kyang rjes 'jug kun/ /chos bshad la 'byams zhes 'phya ba'ang mang / /don de lta na'ang rgyal ba'i bstan/ /chos 'chad nyan rkang gis 'dzin no zhes//gtam mkha' la khyab par sgrog pa yang / /don zhib tu bsam na bden yang bden/ /'dra mi 'dra'i mthong thos mang bo yis/ /yid nying 'jags dkrogs pa'i dus kyi tshe// chos bshad sgrub phyogs su ma lhung ba'i/ /pha bla ma'i mdzad 'phrin mig la shar/ /bod gzhis byes bstan 'dzin mang na yang / /tshos chos su 'chad dang sgrub pa la/ /pha bla ma khyod 'drar mjal dka' bas//sku'i gzi byin dran bzhin thal mo sbyor/ /zhabs spyi bor blangs pa tsam la yang sems ma bde'i snang ba 'gag 'gro ba'i/ /rje'i gsang gsum byin rlabs ngo mtshar ba/ /yul bskal bas mjal dkas snang ba skyo/ /las skal bas rgya gar 'phags yul mpa /mtshan thun gcig rmi lam rmis pa bzhin/ /yul byes gyar pha khyod dran pa'i bus/ /tshig lab brdol glu yi 'gyur khug 'di/ /tshe 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /pha bla ma khyod dang mi 'bral zhing / /gsung rnar snyan nyams len mthar gakhyol te/ /dpal sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs zin par zugagces pyi lo 2 zla 1 tshes 25 la thol byung du gus 'bangs pa rong bo blo bzang snyan grags skya gus pas bstags pa'i zhu yig
'azin yig gi rab byed/ 171brtan gsesnal pyis pa'i mgur dbyangs/yab rje bla ma 7shar gdong blo bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas la 'grin du phul ba/ge(/tsha rabargya/ /bla ma dbyer med kyi mkha' spyod dbang mo khyod/ /rjes chags zur mig gi 'dzum ba mi gtong zhing / /rdo rje glu dbyangs kyi sil snyan dkrol ba la/ /lag sor dam lhod kyi ram 'degs ma stod cig /yi dam dbyer med kyi bla ma spyan ras gzigs/ /dung dung mos gus kyis gsol ba 'debs lags na/ /yul gyar rgyang ring gi bu la snying rje nas/ /zugs brtse'i skyabs 'jug de ma 'dor bla ma mkhyen/ /bajid chags dpal stug gi rma rgyal lhun po khyod//ri gling 'bum phrag gi rgyan du bzhugs shig dang / /dwangs gtsang gser ldan gyi rma chu sngon mo nga / /zhi bde rgya mtsho ru bskor nas mjal 'tshal lo/ /me tog khra bzhad kyi skyed tshal yangs po khyod/ /gshog yangs bung ba yi nyer 'tshor bzhugs shig dang / /'phur lding rol gar la byang ba'i rkang drug nga / /phyogs gzhan sbrang ji ror spyad nas slar yong ngo / /dbyar gsum rdzo ljang gi mon yul nags tshal khyod/ /rang mdog 'gyur med kyi dpal du bzhugs shag dang / /ko rka'i gdangs stan sgya gzhan gsos bu mo nga / /'phags yul drod ldan nas mar yang 'byon 'tshal lo/ /phugs brtsan drod khol gyi brag dmar bya tshang khyod/ /nying 'jags dkrogs med du bde bar bzhugs shig dang / /gshog shugs rtsal sbyang gi khyung drug dkar mo nga / /gnam 'phang chod tshad cig bcal nas slar yong ngo / /shel dkar mdangs bzang gi jo mo glang ma khyod// gzi byin 'dzam gling du 'phro bzhin bzhugs shig dang / /par khyim rjer bgrad kyi seng phrug dkar mo nga / /gangs ri'i rang khyim du bde bar 'jug 'tshal lo rin chen gter mdzod kyi ma pham g.yu mtsho khyod/ /dgung sngon char sprin gyi rten du bzhugs shig dang / /gshog drug rtsal sbyong gi sto dkar nya mo nga / /nub kyi rgya mtsho ru 'khyam nas mjal
172gser gyi ba bong /'tshal lo/ /sgrin dkar mthon mazing gi mkha' dbyings mtshes ma khyod/ /skar tshogs dung rgyur gyi khyim du bzhugs shig dang / /gling bzhir na'or bzod kyi nyi ma gnon nu nga / /nub gling ltad mo la g.yeng nas mjal 'tshal lo/ /steng 'thung bsung zhim gyi ku mud skyed tshal khyod/ /rkang drug 'bum tshogs kyi nyer 'tshor bzhugs shig dang / /dkar gsal 'od ldan gyi lha zla dkar po nga / /gling bzhi'i phang ba ru bskor nas mjal 'tshal lo/ /pha mtha' kun bral gyi nathang yangs po khyod/ /dgun gyi lhags rlung gis mi 3khyer bzhugs shig dang / /snang ba rang skyed kyi shwa ba yu mo nga / /chu klung dal 'bab de btungs nas slar yong ngo / /'gyur med rdo rje'i sku can grub rigs brgya'i bdag /dkyil gsar rgya mtsho cher slo bsdus bzhugs shig dang / /dam sdom khas len la dpa' ba'i slob ma nga / /phyogs gzhan rgyal khams la bskor nas mjal 'tshal lo//rnam grangs mtha' yas kyi rigs pas stong ba nyid/ /gtan 'phebs ston pa khyod bde bar bzhugs shig dang / /'jig lta'i 'dzin stangs la zhen 'dzin slongs rtul nga / /lta ba'i 'byung gnas 'di bskor nas mjal 'tshal lo / /mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi nyams bzhes cha tshang ba/ /dpe don lam rim du 'chad bzhin bzhugs shig dang / /zos rkyang stong 'ur gyi kha bshad mgo mkhregs nga / /byes 'byor bro ba zhig myangs nas mjal 'tshal lo/ /'jin las kun khyab kyi dpal stug gsang ba'i bdag /thub bstan shar phyogs su spel nas bzhugs shig dang / /phyag na padmos kyang rnyed dka'i go skabs de/ /dus bab bstan 'gro la phan ba'i gsos su che/ /phyi nang gzhis byes kyi mig 'bur gtod sa khyod/ /dus skabs gnyan 'brang gi bstan dang 'gro ba la/ /shugs brtse lhod med kyi gau cha lhur bzhes nas/ /tshe 'od dpag med kyi ngo bor brtan par bzhugs/ /mi bzad snyigs ma yi dug mtsho brdol ba 'dir/ /yab gcig bla ma khyod btang snyoms mdzad lags na/ /sngon gyi thugs dam des ci 'tshal ma dgongs shing / /nyam thag slob 'bangs rnams su zhig skyabs bsten 'gyur/ /thog mtha' bar

'azin yig gi rab byed/ 175zhu 'phrin gzhan gzugs bu mo'i mgrin glu/yab rje bla ma 7shar gdong blo bzang bsha( snyobadu sbyi ༵rta'i zhal snga nas bee cin du bzhugs skabs 4༄ rkorabargya/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bshad sgrub ma lus pa/ /che ba bzhi ldan lam gyi go rim pu /rgya mtsho'i lha mo bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /'doms mdzad yab gcig dge legs sbyangs ba'i drung / /pyi rol khri phrag ri chus bskal na yang / /nang gi snang bar khyod skya sku gsung zugs//snying gi khang bzang ma sa pa'i dbal yon du/ /'bral med bdud rtsis bskyangs pa slob ma'i mchid/ /ji ltar nyam thag 'gro pyir sangs rgyas rnams/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi 'khor los bcings pa'i 'gror/ /shin tu nying rjes ma bzod zhing yangs por/ /sgyu ma'i rol bar 'byams ba'i ltad mo che/ /mgon khyod blo bzang rgyal ba'i gdan sa ru/ /dus chis bsgyel ba'i zub bstan rwa dza ka /bshad sgrub dpung bas bsnyal med bsgreng ba la/ /ched du rol gar mdzad pa bsam mi khyab/ /bdag kyang skal ba dman bas ma nyes te/ /brtsebs ma dor gdams pas rjes bzung zhing / /chos dang lugs kyi 'gro stangs rgya che'i gtam/ /rna ba'i bdud jir phyong ba drin du che/ /'das pa'i lo zla mtshan mo'i rmi lam bzhin/ /snang la snying pos dben ba mi che'i las/ /zin med 'di snang g.yeng ba bkram pa'i rgyar/ /dbang med bcings pa'i las la gting nas 'akyod/ /ci tsam 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i 'chad nyan yang / /gu dog chos brgyad gdon gyi ngo 'dzin las/ /'u ltar sgrub dang ci'i pyir bya ba kun/ /lung pa gcig la 'angags pa'i 'gro stangs tsam/ /rang phyogs gces par 'dzin pas blo bslad pa'i/ /sdod pa'i dgon dang yig cha gcig tsam la/ /yid skya tshangs zig phyogs lhung 'azen 'khyer gyis/ /gargyag ba'i yul du mi tshe pyed ka bskyal/ /'on kyang kun khyab kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /yab gcig khyod zhal tshangs pa'i mgur dbyangs las/ /brtse bas gdams pa rin chen nor bu'i char//
